added.title: Engineer Lead, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
added.description:
Position Type

Full time

Type Of Hire

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

Job Description

Innovation isn’t just what we do; it’s how we work. At FIS, you’ll collaborate with talented people across the globe to create solutions that shape the way the world pays, banks and invests. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful impact, we’d love to meet you.

About The Role

As a Lead Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer, you will join a growing AI Platform organization and provide technical leadership within the Evaluation & Compliance area. You will remain hands-on while setting direction and leading execution across complex production AI initiatives, with particular focus on GenAI agents, agent platforms, evaluation, performance measurement, CI quality gates, guardrails and engineering standards. You will partner across product, platform, data, risk, compliance and business teams.

Your key responsibilities

Set technical direction for production AI/ML systems and translate ambiguous business opportunities into architectures, workstreams, decision criteria and measurable outcomes
Lead the design, deployment and operation of generative AI and agentic architectures, including models, orchestration, tools, retrieval, data flows, safety controls and enterprise integrations
Establish evaluation strategy and quality gates spanning baselines, gold datasets, automated and human evaluation, statistical analysis, regression testing and production monitoring
Define reusable standards and reference patterns for observability, traceability, security, privacy, responsible AI, release management and operational readiness
Lead architecture and design reviews; identify failure modes, technical debt, scalability constraints and build-versus-buy tradeoffs before they become delivery risks
Guide optimization of AI systems across accuracy, latency, throughput, reliability, infrastructure consumption and model or token cost
Shape AI-agent platform capabilities and reusable services that enable teams to safely build, evaluate, deploy and operate agents at scale through APIs, event-driven services and protocols such as MCP or comparable patterns
Partner with Product, Platform, Risk, Compliance, Legal and domain leaders to align technical decisions with client needs, regulatory obligations and business priorities
Lead complex incident resolution and root-cause analysis across models, data, prompts, tools, infrastructure and evaluation systems
Create technical roadmaps, decompose work across engineers and teams, manage dependencies and communicate decisions and risks to senior stakeholders
Mentor senior and developing engineers, improve engineering review practices and build a culture of disciplined experimentation, documentation and accountable delivery
Evaluate emerging models, frameworks and vendors through evidence-based prototypes and recommend adoption, containment or retirement based on measurable value and risk

What you bring

Required Qualifications

Deep hands-on experience designing, building, deploying and operating GenAI agents or agentic systems in production, including substantial ownership of AI-agent or AI-platform capabilities. Generic exposure to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or prompt engineering alone is not sufficient
Strong coding and software engineering expertise in Python, Java or another relevant production language, including architecture, APIs, distributed systems, testing, CI/CD, version control and production troubleshooting
Demonstrated experience leading AI/ML architecture decisions and establishing evaluation, deployment or operational standards used by other engineers
Experience with modern generative AI and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, prompting, context design and failure handling
Experience designing rigorous evaluation programs that connect offline quality, human review, production telemetry and business outcomes
Experience with cloud-native production environments, containers, Kubernetes, observability and secure integration with enterprise data and services
Ability to influence across organizational boundaries, communicate complex tradeoffs to executive and technical audiences and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority
A university degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building AI platforms, evaluation platforms, model gateways, agent runtimes or shared developer capabilities used across multiple teams
Experience with MCP or comparable tool-integration protocols, Langfuse or equivalent observability, Snowflake, GitHub Actions and Kubernetes
Knowledge of model risk management, responsible AI, information security, privacy and regulated financial-services environments
Experience with champion-challenger approaches, controlled rollouts, feature flags and measurable optimization of cost, latency and quality
Experience conducting technical due diligence and build-versus-buy analysis for AI models, platforms and vendors
History of mentoring senior engineers, leading technical communities or establishing engineering standards across teams

The impact you will make

You will help FIS scale from individual AI implementations to durable enterprise capabilities. Your leadership will improve architecture consistency, evaluation discipline, production reliability and responsible adoption while shortening the path from experimentation to measurable client and business value.

What we offer you

Ready to build what's next? At FIS, you'll have the opportunity to influence the future of AI in fintech, grow other technical leaders and help create technology that powers the global economy.

Opportunities to lead innovation in fintech
Tools for personal and professional growth
Internal career growth opportunities
An inclusive and diverse work environment
Resources to invest in your community

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

EEOC Statement

FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here

For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer~ In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

added.title: AI Application Engineer
added.description:
The AI/ML Engineer is a hands-on technical role within Dematic’s Shared Technical Services team, responsible for building, deploying, integrating, and operating production AI solutions across the enterprise.

This is a builder role, not a strategy, governance, or primarily research-oriented position. The engineer will work directly with business teams, AI solution architects, data engineers, product leads, and enterprise technology teams to turn prioritized AI opportunities into secure, reliable, scalable solutions that operate in real business workflows.

The role spans traditional machine learning, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, APIs, workflow automation, and related AI engineering patterns. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing code, troubleshooting integrations, evaluating models, building pipelines, deploying services, and supporting solutions once they are in production.

We offer:

Career Development
Competitive Compensation and Benefits
Pay Transparency
Global Opportunities

Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer

Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $133,000 -$180,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

Tasks and Qualifications:

What You Will Do:

Build Production AI Solutions

Design, develop, test, and deploy production-grade AI and machine learning applications.
Translate prototypes and proofs of concept into reliable, maintainable production solutions.
Build AI services, APIs, backend components, and integrations connecting AI capabilities to enterprise applications and workflows.
Develop solutions using large language models, machine learning models, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and other AI technologies.
Write clean, testable, maintainable Python and related application code.
Take direct technical ownership for assigned solutions from development through production deployment.

Build Generative AI and Agentic Solutions

Build LLM-powered applications using prompting, structured outputs, tool/function calling, embeddings, vector search, and RAG.
Develop AI agents that can reason across business information, call enterprise tools and APIs, and execute multi-step workflows.
Build retrieval pipelines over structured and unstructured enterprise information.
Implement evaluation mechanisms for retrieval quality, groundedness, answer quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
Experiment with models and architectures, but rapidly convert successful experiments into production-ready implementations.

Integrate AI Into Enterprise Workflows

Connect AI solutions with enterprise platforms, applications, APIs, data sources, and business processes.
Build integrations that allow AI capabilities to operate inside existing user workflows rather than as disconnected demonstrations.
Work with Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, enterprise APIs, data platforms, and other approved technologies where appropriate.
Collaborate with enterprise application and platform teams to integrate AI capabilities with systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, SharePoint, Teams, and other business platforms.

Productionize and Operate AI

Build CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes for AI applications and models.
Implement production monitoring for availability, latency, errors, model behavior, token consumption, quality, and cost.
Establish appropriate logging, tracing, alerting, versioning, and observability.
Implement model and prompt versioning, evaluation, rollback, and release-management practices.
Diagnose and resolve production issues across models, data, APIs, infrastructure, retrieval pipelines, and application code.
Improve solutions based on production usage and user feedback.

Engineer For Enterprise Requirements

Build solutions that meet enterprise security, privacy, responsible AI, architecture, and data-handling requirements.
Implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, access controls, logging, and appropriate data protections.
Design AI components for reuse where multiple business solutions require similar capabilities.
Document technical architecture, dependencies, interfaces, operational procedures, and known limitations.
Ensure solutions can be supported by teams other than the original developer.

Work Across Business Domains

Shared Technical Services operates as a reusable engineering capability across Dematic rather than as an engineering team for one business function.

The engineer will therefore:

Move between prioritized AI initiatives as business demand changes.
Become productive quickly in unfamiliar business domains.
Work directly with business SMEs to understand processes, data, and technical requirements.
Partner with AI solution architects and product leads to determine practical implementation approaches.
Identify reusable components and patterns instead of repeatedly building one-off solutions.
Provide technical estimates and surface delivery risks early.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of hands-on software, machine learning, data, or AI engineering experience.
Demonstrated experience deploying software, ML, or AI solutions into production environments, not solely developing prototypes or analytical models.
Strong Python development skills.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating systems.
Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks and libraries.
Practical experience developing applications with large language models.
Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, or equivalent GenAI patterns.
Experience with Git-based software development, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
Understanding of databases, data pipelines, structured and unstructured data, and data quality.
Experience monitoring and troubleshooting production applications.
Ability to independently move from loosely defined business requirements to working technical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, AKS, or similar cloud technologies.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, and related features.
Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows.
Experience with orchestration frameworks and AI application development patterns.
Experience with vector databases and enterprise search/retrieval architectures.
Experience with MLflow or equivalent model lifecycle tooling.
Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.
Experience integrating AI with platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Databricks, Snowflake, SharePoint, or Microsoft Teams.
Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, responsible AI, and AI security practices.
Experience working in manufacturing, supply chain, industrial automation, engineering, finance, or other complex enterprise environments.

What Success Looks Lik
e

Success in this role is measured primarily by AI capabilities running reliably in production and delivering business outcomes, not the number of prototypes created.

A strong AI/ML Engineer will:

Turn promising AI concepts into production solutions.
Ship working capabilities frequently rather than allowing projects to remain in proof-of-concept mode.
Build solutions that are secure, observable, maintainable, and supportable.
Reduce the time required to move from business requirement to production.
Create reusable AI engineering patterns that accelerate future projects.
Resolve technical problems directly rather than continually handing them to other teams.
Improve production solutions based on measurable usage, quality, reliability, cost, and business results.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa now or in the future.

added.title: Senior AI/SI Task Lead
added.description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

The Strategic Technology and Economic Foresight (STEF) department delivers objective technical analysis, test and evaluation (T&E), and research program support that help Intelligence Community sponsors assess and transition emerging technologies.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Technology and Economic Foresight Department seeks a. STEF seeks a Senior Artificial Intelligence (AI) Task Lead (TL) to lead MITRE's T&E role on a research program developing AI-generated, mission-tailored imagery and geospatial data. As a technical lead, the TL is accountable for contributing to the technical development, work shaping, sponsor engagement, execution, and outcomes of MITRE's work.

The selected candidate will be expected to:

Adapt academic and industry research in AI/SI/agentic systems to address sponsors' unique data sources and challenging problem sets.
Design and implement software-based T&E methods to baseline, assess, and compare IARPA performer solutions.
Analyze diverse data sources, including remote sensing imagery (EO, SAR, infrared), open-source intelligence (OSINT), and signals data.
Collaborate with technical staff and project leadership to develop innovative solutions and lead small teams in their implementation.
Develop and deliver high-quality technical products and deliverables that meet sponsor requirements.
Translate project strategy into actionable technical objectives, deliverables, and outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience.
Typically requires a degree in artificial intelligence, data science, electrical engineering, software engineering, imaging, or related disciplines and work experience with a strong technical background.
Proficiency with Python, PyTorch, LangChain/LangGraph, AI enabled coding tools, and other modern AI tools
Demonstrated experience leading tasks for Government sponsors and development of high-quality technical products.
Demonstrated ability to deliver clear and concise deliverables to Government sponsors.
Capable, self-motivated, collaborative
Must have an active Top Secret/SCI w/Poly U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.
This position has an on-site requirement of 3 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s or PhD with research experience in one of the above specified degree programs 
Proficiency with Python, PyTorch, LangChain/LangGraph, agentic coding tools (codex, claude code, cursor), containerization (docker), code collaboration tools (git)
Domian knowledge of emerging and current sponsor related technology fields: Geospatial intelligence, AI / ML, Data Science, Image Processing / Computer Vision, various GIS data (SAR, HSI, Trajectories, etc.)
Experience evaluating AI/ML systems, particularly black-box evaluation of systems whose internal implementations cannot be inspected, including familiarity with evaluation methodologies, performance metrics, and verification and validation (V&V).
Ability to mentor early-career staff, new task leaders, and encourage staff skill development
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex task components simultaneously

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI/Polygraph

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Top Secret/SCI/Polygraph

Salary compensation range and midpoint:

$143,600 - $179,500 - $215,400 Annual

Work Location Type:

Onsite

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law.

MITRE intends to maintain a website that is fully accessible to all individuals. If you are unable to search or apply for jobs and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of MITRE’s employment process, please email recruitinghelp@mitre.org for general support and collegerecruiting@mitre.org for intern positions. This service is for individuals requiring reasonable accommodation requests. Please note that vendor solicitations will not receive a reply.

added.title: Agentic AI Solutions Architect, Conversational AI
added.description:
We are helping a leading technology contractor build an elite team of hands on Solutions Architects to put AI agents in front of millions of callers. The work replaces a traditional phone tree with agents that understand what a person needs, carry the conversation, and resolve the request. No federal or government background is required: if you have architected and built production services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and want to apply that to agentic AI at real scale, this team wants to talk to you.

What You Will Do

Architect and build AI agents that understand intent, keep context across a conversation, and complete multistep tasks for real customers
Design end to end cloud solutions that connect large language models to contact center platforms such as Amazon Connect and Amazon Lex
Build the APIs, microservices, and integrations that let agents look up records and take action in enterprise systems
Design agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and prompt strategies, then measure and improve accuracy, latency, and containment
Build in security, privacy safeguards, and clean escalation to a live agent
Move fast with a small, high performing team: prototype, ship, measure, and iterate through CI/CD

Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 12+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree)
Solutions architecture experience: you have designed and built services that run in production on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
Hands on development in Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Java, or a similar language
Experience building or integrating LLM powered systems, conversational AI, or AI/ML solutions
Working knowledge of agentic AI: orchestration, tool calling, context management, and automated workflows
REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration
Flexible work location: remote, hybrid, or onsite in the Baltimore, MD area (remote team members travel to Baltimore about once a month)
Eastern time zone preferred; remote candidates should be able to work East Coast business hours
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust

Preferred

Professional level cloud certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
Amazon Connect experience of any depth, or contact center work with Amazon Lex, Genesys Cloud, or Twilio
LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Bedrock Agents, or similar frameworks
AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or OpenAI APIs
Voice AI with speech to text and text to speech
RAG, vector databases, and semantic search
Serverless, containers, and Kubernetes (Lambda, API Gateway, Docker)
LLM evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices

added.title: AI DEVELOPER II
added.description:
Date: Sep 1, 2026

Location:

Inglewood, CA, US, 90302

Company: Marvin Engineering Co.

Req ID: 1648

FLSA Status: Exempt

Pay Range: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on factors such as work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Offers reflect the total compensation package.

This position is 100% onsite

The Marvin Group is a Strategic Partner for Global Alternate Mission Equipment and Sustainment

The Marvin Group, a leading defense contractor, plays a crucial role in the development and manufacturing of various systems for military aerospace and vehicles. Based in Southern California near the Los Angeles International Airport, The Marvin Group consists of Marvin Engineering (MEC), Marvin Test Solutions (MTS) and Marvin Land Systems (MLS). Marvin Engineering designs and produces military Alternate Mission Equipment. Marvin Test Solutions designs and manufactures armament Test Equipment. Marvin Land Systems specializes in the design and build of power and thermal management systems. For over 60 years we have maintained “A Tradition of Excellence”, serving as a trusted source for our unwavering commitment to supporting all branches of the Department of Defense and our global allies. Our collaboration extends across a diverse array of programs and platforms, including major military prime contractors such as Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and Raytheon.

Position Summary:

Marvin Group is seeking a hands-on AI Application Developer to rapidly prototype, build, and ship useful AI-enabled internal applications. The developer works directly with users, turns practical workflow needs into maintainable software, and improves solutions through feedback and measured results.

This is a hands-on, experienced technical individual-contributor role for a builder who can translate real business, engineering, operational, and information-management needs into functioning AI-enabled software. The Applied AI Developer works directly with business users, operations, engineering, IT, and leadership to identify high-value automation opportunities; rapidly build practical solutions; integrate them with existing systems; and transition successful prototypes into secure, reliable, maintainable production applications.

The role combines modern application development, AI/LLM application engineering, API and database integration, intelligent workflow design, cloud-hosted deployment, and practical business-process automation.

This is not an academic AI research role, a pure data-science role, a prompt-writing role, a no-code automation role, or a traditional IT-support role. The role is focused on practical delivery of production applications, AI-enabled tools, agents, integrations, and business automations.

Essential Responsibilities:

Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve AI-enabled applications, web applications, internal tools, workflow automations, and business systems.
Work directly with stakeholders to identify operational, engineering, business-process, information-management, and automation opportunities suitable for AI-enabled solutions.
Translate business requirements and ambiguous operational problems into practical technical architectures, prototypes, deployed applications, and maintainable production systems.
Build applications using modern technologies such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL, REST APIs, databases, web services, and cloud-based application platforms.
Develop applications using frontier large language model platforms, including OpenAI GPT/Codex, Anthropic Claude/Claude Code, Google Gemini, or comparable technologies.
Design and implement AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation systems, semantic-search applications, knowledge-retrieval tools, structured-output workflows, tool/function-calling systems, document-processing systems, and multi-step AI automations.
Integrate AI-enabled applications with enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, databases, APIs, file repositories, operational systems, cloud services, and external data sources.
Use AI-assisted software-engineering environments and coding agents, including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools, to accelerate design, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and maintenance.

added.title: AI Engineer
added.description:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we’ve processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

At Certa, AI agents do real work for enterprise risk and procurement teams: Studio designs workflows, Data Agent answers questions over customer data, and Risk Agent assesses third parties. The model is the same one everyone can buy - the harness is what makes ours do the job reliably, safely, and cheaply, and you’ll own that harness. This isn’t a “build AI features” role: you own an agent end to end and you’re measured on whether it does the task - success rate, latency, cost per task, and what customers stop doing by hand. It’s a small team with high ownership, where you’ll work directly with PMs, design, and customers, and be trusted to make the call.

What You’ll Do

Own the agent loop: Step control, planning, retries, error feedback, subagents, and parallel tool calls for long, multi-step tasks.
Design tools & actions: Build the tools, MCP servers, and skills our agents use - narrow, well-described, permissioned, and safe to call against customer data.
Engineer context: Decide what the model sees on every step - compaction, memory, retrieval-as-a-tool, and how agents read large enterprise records without drowning.
Build evals that gate every change: Golden sets, regression suites, and trace-based scoring wired into CI, so no prompt, model, or harness change ships blind.
Own model choices & the runtime: Route across models on capability, latency, and cost, running new model launches through the eval suite and re-tuning the harness when the frontier moves, with durable sessions, sandboxed execution, nested-trace observability, token budgets, and graceful fallbacks for multi-tenant enterprise customers.
Own the backend systems: Design services end to end (data model, APIs, storage choice, failure modes), build async pipelines (queues, workers, retries, idempotency, backpressure), and make them fast and cheap at scale (caching, batching, indexing, p95/p99 latency budgets) on multi-tenant AWS with isolation, least-privilege access, PII handling, and audit trails.
Own it in production: Write the design doc, weigh the trade-offs, defend them in review, and own the service in production.

What Success Looks Like

Day 30 - Backend: Own one Studio backend service end to end and ship a production change (a new API, a pipeline fix, or a performance improvement) with a measurable result, such as a lower p95 latency or error rate, and join its on-call rotation.
Day 60 - Fix: Find the top failure mode of an existing agent from its traces and ship a fix that lifts its task success rate by a measurable amount on our eval set (target: +10 points).
Day 90 - Build: Ship one new agent capability or backend service you designed from scratch, live with at least one customer, with a written design doc and a target metric you set and hit.

What You’ll Need

Backend & system design: 3+ years building production backend systems with strong system design - you’ve designed and scaled services under real load, picked the data stores, modeled the data, and handled async processing, queues, caching, idempotency, and failure in production. Python preferred.
Shipped an agent: You’ve shipped at least one LLM agent to real users and can explain its loop, its tools, its failure modes, and the numbers that showed it worked.
Evals that change decisions: You’ve built evals that changed a decision - you killed, shipped, or reworked something because the eval said so.
Context & tool design instincts: Strong instincts for context and tool design, able to say why an agent failed by reading its trace.
Works with coding agents: You use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as a core part of how you work, and have opinions about what makes a harness good.
Owns outcomes: A record of owning outcomes - you pick the metric, move it, and report honestly when it doesn’t move.
Nice to have: Built or contributed to an agent harness, framework, or orchestration layer (open source counts); enterprise B2B in a regulated domain (PII, audit trails, permissions, SOC 2); founder or founding-engineer experience; and any framework (LangGraph, Agent SDKs, Deep Agents) or none - we care about the judgment, not the library.

Compensation And Benefits

Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity
Time off: 49 days paid time off
Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans
Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus
Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

London
San Francisco
Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we’re defining the category, not following it.
Industry recognition. We’ve been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group’s 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.
A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes’ Best Startup Employers in the US. We’re a fast-growing company where you’ll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.
Real scale with strong backing. We’ve processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We’re well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We’re excited to meet you!

added.title: Principal Applied Scientist, Alexa Shopping
added.description:
Description

Alexa+ is transforming how hundreds of millions of customers shop by voice, and the ambition is simple to state: every action a customer can take in the Amazon Store, they should be able to take by talking to Alexa. Getting there turns on one scientific question: how do we know an agent is good enough to act on a customer's behalf? We're looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to own that science for all of Alexa Shopping. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. Your customers are the shopping verticals - roughly fifteen of them - and your job is to raise what an agent can reliably do for them, and to make rigorous measurement the default instead of something each team rebuilds. You will frame the problems yourself; examples include the harness that makes an agent reliable at multi-step shopping tasks - planning, routing, tool use, context, recovery from partial failure - and the evaluation science that proves it works: how to grade a conversation that can fail at any step, how to validate the graders themselves, and how to catch regressions in production across locales and endpoints. If the business needs model work that does not exist here today, you are the person who sees that and makes the case for it. You will advise the organization's leadership, shape architecture across teams, and present your direction to Directors and VPs.

Key job responsibilities

Personally invent new scientific techniques and paradigms for highly ambiguous problems in agent reasoning, evaluation, and reliability, where neither the approach nor the success criteria are predefined.

Invent and build the agent harness for shopping tasks - planning, routing, tool use, context, recovery from partial failure - writing the critical parts yourself and holding it to production standards.

Define the methods and metrics that decide whether an agent is ready to act on a customer's behalf: automated grading, validating the graders, and catching regressions in production.

Own the long-term science roadmap for agentic shopping, broken down into programs that span multiple teams.

Draw attention to latent science challenges and spark new research directions, including evaluating whether model training or adaptation is worth standing up.

Drive adoption of your methods across the shopping verticals, favoring reuse over rebuilding.

Bring scientific context to strategic decisions by probing assumptions and surfacing pitfalls, and explain trade-offs to leaders up to three levels above you.

Mentor scientists, help managers guide their growth, and raise the hiring bar.

Where business considerations allow, publish and represent Amazon externally.

About The Team

The Alexa Shopping team owns the Shopping experiences customers use on all Alexa devices (Echo, Echo Show, Alexa App, Fire TV). With Gen AI and LLMs, we are reinventing shopping as a voice + touch experience that spans the full lifecycle - discovery, search, purchase, reorder, order tracking, and post-purchase support - across all product categories and worldwide marketplaces. The goal is agents that can act on a customer's behalf at every one of those steps.

Basic Qualifications

PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
Experience in Java, C++, Python, or a related language
10+ years of experience inventing and shipping large-scale, customer-facing ML or AI systems with measurable customer or business impact
Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
Experience designing evaluation methods, metrics, and experiments for production ML or generative AI systems, and using the results to decide what ships
Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
Experience influencing scientific and architectural decisions across multiple teams in an organization, not only within one team
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agent harnesses at production scale - planning, tool and API use, context management, multi-step task completion
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for generative AI systems, including LLM-as-judge methods and how those judges are validated
Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or adaptation for LLM-based systems
Experience with conversational AI, speech, or multi-modal experiences that combine voice and screen
Experience applying AI to e-commerce or retail: personalization, recommendation, search, or conversational commerce
Experience building science methods or tooling that other teams adopted and kept using after you moved on

Data Scientist III (Senior) – Digital Product Services Team

URGENT NEED!

Target start date of December 7.
Interview screenings can begin closer to December 1.

• Step 3: Follow-up screening with Director level staff as the final sign-off- Virtual/video

Role & Skill Requirements

The role follows the digital product release cycle
: the team partners with business, product and IT to define how a change will be measured, what data is needed, and after launch tracks and quantifies the impact and reports back to business, product and IT, working much like a product analytics group with heavy A/B testing, statistics and experimentation support focused on digital customer behavior.

• Solid SQL is required
, and Snowflake experience is a plus
since most data lives there; other platforms are not usually too different.

• R or Python experience required
— the team is agnostic between them.

• Tableau, Power BI and dashboarding generally are not a priority for this team.

• Statistics and stakeholder management are big, particularly taking non-technical stakeholders' data needs from concept to reality and operating in an unclear space where the data does not yet exist.

• Master's degree preferred
or Bachelor's-level candidates with a
few years in a very related digital product release field.
Experience over the master's degree, especially over someone fresh out of a degree, as fresh graduates have sometimes not been the best fit for large real-world data and the private business world.

• Digital analytics or platform experience is not mandatory
; people from backgrounds such as quantitative psychology have become successful team members as long as they can adjust to the content.

• Snowflake is the primary database
, with some AWS Athena and a little SQL Server;
Experience with all of those are not a must, Snowflake is a plus.

• Personality:
Willing to ask questions, curious, admits when they don't know something and willing to learn — things change a lot in this environment and the team learns from each other continuously. This person will balance analysis with development, knowing when to jump in and knowing when to step back to lend their expertise.

Feature & Functional Design

Data scientists are embedded in the team’s designing the feature . Their main job here is to define the data tracking needed to evaluate the business case—things like event logging, Adobe tagging, third-party data ingestion, and any other tracking requirements.
They are also meant to consult and outline if/when business should be bringing data into the bank and will help connect business with CDAO and IT warehousing and data engineering partners should new data need to be brought forward.

Feature Engineering & Development

The same data scientists stay involved as the feature moves into execution. They support all necessary functions (Amigo, QA, etc.) to ensure data tracking is in place when the feature goes live.
They also begin preparing to support launch evaluation and measurement against experimentation design or business case success criteria.

Feature Rollout & Performance Evaluation

Owns tracking the rollout, running A/B tests, and conducting impact analysis for all features that they have been involved in the Feature & Functional Design and Feature Engineering & Development stages.
They provide an unbiased view of how the feature performs against the original business case along with making objective recommendations that will provide direction for business. They will roll off once the feature has matured through business case/experiment design and evaluation.

In addition to supporting feature rollouts…

Data scientists on the team are also encouraged to pursue self-driven initiatives during periods when they are not actively supporting other projects. These initiatives may include designing experiments, conducting exploratory analyses, developing predictive models, or identifying new opportunities for impact.

The John A. Reif, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at NJIT seeks a Senior Transportation Research Engineer at the Intelligent Transportation Systems Resource Center (ITSRC). As a research and technology resource for NJDOT, ITSRC advances transportation systems management and operations (TSM&O) through traffic monitoring, incident management, active traffic management, work-zone safety, and connected and automated transportation. Within this program, the candidate will conduct AI-focused research on traffic operations and safety, including adaptive signal control, autonomous-vehicle planning and control, multimodal hazard detection, and digital twins. Work will integrate roadside sensing, field data, traffic and driving simulation, software- and hardware-in-the-loop experiments, and evaluation of emerging technologies. The associate will collaborate with ITSRC investigators and transportation-agency partners, publish findings, prepare technical reports, and develop practical methods with potential applications beyond New Jersey.

The candidate will develop and rigorously evaluate research methods and prototypes, document simulation and field-test results, publish scholarly findings, and deliver technical reports or demonstrations to support transportation-agency decisions. Research outputs should be reproducible, transferable, and relevant to practical improvements in roadway safety, mobility, and operations.

Essential Functions

Lead the technical execution of original research: formulate testable research questions, design experimental protocols, develop methods, perform quantitative analysis, and document limitations and reproducibility.
Develop, adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate machine-learning systems for traffic operations and safety, including reinforcement learning, large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and System One Models (S1Ms) for structured, confidence-aware decision support.
Implement and benchmark locally hosted AI inference and model adaptation workflows; assess accuracy, generalization, latency, computational demands, uncertainty, and appropriate safeguards for safety-sensitive transportation applications.
Design and integrate roadside LiDAR, camera, radar, edge-computing, and communications systems; perform field deployment, calibration, synchronized data collection, quality assurance, and sensor-fusion analysis.
Develop AI-enabled approaches for adaptive signal control, congestion and incident management, and real-time detection of stopped vehicles, unsafe movements, work-zone intrusions, and other critical roadway events.
Create and calibrate transportation digital twins using tools such as PTV Vissim, SUMO, and CARLA; integrate empirical traffic, trajectory, and sensor data to assess operational and safety outcomes.
Programmatically control and automate PTV Vissim experiments through its COM interface, including Python-based scenario generation, parameter calibration, traffic-signal control integration, batch simulation, optimization, and results extraction.
Validate methods through simulation, software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, and field studies when appropriate; evaluate safety, reliability, operational performance, and practical deployment constraints.
Prepare peer-reviewed manuscripts, conference presentations, reproducible technical documentation, and sponsor reports; communicate results and support technology transfer to transportation-agency partners.
Contribute to research proposals and interdisciplinary collaborations; mentor graduate and undergraduate researchers and help coordinate laboratory experiments and field activities.

Pre-Requisite Qualifications

Ph.D. in Transportation Engineering, or a closely related field by the effective date of the postdoctoral appointment, consistent with NJIT appointment requirements.
Demonstrated research experience applying big data analytics, machine learning or advanced computational methods to transportation operations, intelligent transportation systems, or roadway safety.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with machine-learning, numerical-analysis, or high-volume data-processing libraries.
Hands-on experience with transportation simulation, traffic sensor/trajectory data analysis, or integrated computational testbeds; ability to connect models with real-world datasets.
Record of scholarly research output, including peer-reviewed publications or accepted scholarly contributions, appropriate to career stage.
Demonstrated capacity to plan and evaluate research independently while collaborating effectively with faculty, students, and external partners; strong technical writing and oral communication skills.

Department

Intelligent Transportation System Resource Center

Preferred Qualifications

Expert-level proficiency with PTV Vissim and its COM interface, especially Python-controlled simulation automation, traffic-signal control, calibration, optimization, and extraction of detailed simulation outputs.
Practical experience fine-tuning and using LLMs, VLMs, and System One Models (S1Ms) on local computing systems, including efficient inference, deployment, and model evaluation.
Research experience with multi-agent reinforcement learning, generative-AI-supported decision-making, interpretable AI, or safety-aware transportation control.
Direct field experience deploying and calibrating roadside LiDAR, video, or radar systems; experience with point-cloud analytics, multi-sensor fusion, MQTT, or edge computing.
Experience with digital twins, trajectory-based simulation calibration, connected-vehicle data, and/or software- or hardware-in-the-loop integration with traffic controllers.
Experience developing and evaluating autonomous-vehicle (AV) planning and control systems using ROS 2, CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, NVIDIA Isaac ROS, Autoware, or comparable platforms for closed-loop simulation and scenario-based validation.
Experience evaluating traffic operations and safety under diverse operating conditions, including adverse weather, incidents, highway work zones, and vulnerable-road-user interactions.
Prior contributions to state or federal transportation-agency-sponsored research, field demonstrations, research proposals, technical reports, student mentorship, or agency-facing technology transfer.

added.title: Senior AI Solutions Architect, Leo Intelligence Technologies
added.description:
Description

Help Amazon find the root causes of satellite build and operations issues and stop them from repeating. As a Senior AI Solutions Architect, you'll work with manufacturing, test, reliability, and space operations teams across Amazon Leo to define how AI tackles these problems, prove the right approach with working prototypes, and turn it into requirements engineers build into production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Partner with engineering and operations leaders in manufacturing, test, reliability, and on-orbit operations to understand their root-cause and corrective-action processes, data, and constraints
Help teams you don't manage choose among viable approaches: Make trade-offs explicit, flag one-way-door decisions, recommend an approach with its alternatives, and lead contentious technical issues to a decision through the quality of your reasoning
Build working proofs on the team's domain language model, knowledge platform, and agent framework that show which approach meets the success criteria agreed up front under real constraints, with security, governance, observability, and human oversight designed in from the start
Hand over proofs that are tested, secure, and maintainable by others, with the requirements and architecture that engineers and partner teams build into production
Combine evidence across engagements into platform requirements, turn proven approaches into patterns other teams reuse, and coach architects and engineers so they deliver without you

A day in the life

You start with a reliability engineer reviewing an issue that recurred across three builds, and you map where the evidence lives in test, quality, and telemetry data. Midday, you demo two prototypes, one retrieval-based and one agent-based, that gather that evidence and draft a root-cause hypothesis with citations, and the team picks one against agreed-upon accuracy criteria. In the afternoon, you write the requirements a partner team needs to connect their data, and you review the architecture with the engineer who will build it for production.

About The Team

Leo Intelligence Technologies is the central AI team within Leo Satellite Build Systems. We build shared AI capabilities and applications that help Production Operations make better, faster decisions. Our work spans governed data, domain-specific language models, retrieval and knowledge services, evaluation frameworks, and agentic workflows that factory teams use every day.

Our systems directly influence manufacturing decisions, so we emphasize rigorous experimentation, strong data foundations, clear documentation, and production-ready engineering. Our solutions architects connect the teams we serve, inside and outside Production Operations, to these building blocks and prove what works before we build it.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
2+ years of experience designing or building generative AI or machine learning solutions for production applications
Experience writing working code, such as prototypes, proofs of concept, or production software, in Python or another modern programming language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing generative AI solutions with retrieval-augmented generation, agents, fine-tuning, or evaluation frameworks for enterprise customers
Experience building proofs of concept that customers adopted into production
Experience with root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), reliability engineering, or failure analysis
Experience writing narratives, requirements, or architecture documents for senior leaders
Experience leading technical programs across organizations with competing priorities
Experience with AWS AI and data services, such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, AWS Glue, or Amazon Athena, including in regulated environments such as AWS GovCloud (US)

added.description:
Description

Help the world's leading healthcare and life sciences organizations turn AI, machine learning, and data into outcomes for patients and researchers, in settings where accuracy, safety, and compliance matter. As a Principal Specialist Solutions Architect, you'll set the technical direction for how providers, payers, MedTech, diagnostics, and biopharma companies adopt AI on AWS, from data foundations and machine learning to generative and agentic AI.

This isn't a role where you advise from the sidelines. You'll work directly with customer executives and engineering teams to take AI from experimentation to production: from the first whiteboard session, through hands-on build workshops, to platforms that clinicians, researchers, and operations teams rely on every day.

What You'll Do

Shape multi-year AI and data strategies with customer CTOs, CIOs, and chief medical and digital officers
Define the reference architectures other architects build on, across health data platforms, machine learning, generative and agentic AI, clinical decision support, prior authorization, medical imaging, and genomics
Solve the hard problems that keep regulated AI from reaching production (HIPAA, FDA, GxP): governance, auditability, validation, and data privacy
Turn what you see across customers into requirements that shape the AWS AI roadmap
Lead the technical community through talks, published architectures, and mentoring senior architects

This role can be based anywhere in the US, with up to 30% travel. You'll love it if you want your work to reach patients, if you enjoy being both a strategist and a builder, and if you want to define how AI is done well in one of the most important and most regulated industries.

Key job responsibilities

Set AI/ML and data strategy with healthcare and life sciences executives, define reference architectures others build on, and take regulated AI from pilot to production.
Lead AI/ML and data strategy for healthcare and life sciences customers, define reusable architectures, solve regulated-AI barriers, and shape the AWS AI roadmap.
Guide healthcare and life sciences leaders on AI/ML and data, design architectures others build on, take regulated AI to production, and mentor senior architects.

About The Team

Our team helps healthcare and life sciences organizations use AI, machine learning, and data to improve how care is delivered and how new therapies are discovered. We believe AI in health must be safe, explainable, and built for regulated environments from day one. You'll join a close-knit group of specialist architects who share what we learn openly and work alongside account teams, product and engineering groups, and partners, bringing the customer's voice into how AWS builds its AI services. With hospitals, health plans, medical device makers, and pharma and biotech companies, we build data platforms, clinical and operational AI, and research tools that help clinicians, researchers, and operations teams do their best work.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
5+ years working in or with healthcare and life sciences organizations, such as providers, payers, pharma/biotech, diagnostics, or MedTech. Demonstrated understanding of clinical, R&D, or lab workflows and the data behind them (EHR/FHIR, omics, imaging, clinical trial data).
Experience designing and deploying AI/ML or generative AI solutions that meet regulatory requirements such as HIPAA, GxP, FDA SaMD/21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, or GDPR. This includes model governance, auditability, and validation for regulated workloads.
Hands-on experience taking GenAI and agentic systems to production, such as foundation model selection, RAG, fine-tuning/distillation, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails. Experience on Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or SageMaker is preferred.

added.description:
Description

Help Amazon find the root causes of satellite build and operations issues and stop them from repeating. As a Senior AI Solutions Architect, you'll work with manufacturing, test, reliability, and space operations teams across Amazon Leo to define how AI tackles these problems, prove the right approach with working prototypes, and turn it into requirements engineers build into production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Partner with engineering and operations leaders in manufacturing, test, reliability, and on-orbit operations to understand their root-cause and corrective-action processes, data, and constraints
Help teams you don't manage choose among viable approaches: Make trade-offs explicit, flag one-way-door decisions, recommend an approach with its alternatives, and lead contentious technical issues to a decision through the quality of your reasoning
Build working proofs on the team's domain language model, knowledge platform, and agent framework that show which approach meets the success criteria agreed up front under real constraints, with security, governance, observability, and human oversight designed in from the start
Hand over proofs that are tested, secure, and maintainable by others, with the requirements and architecture that engineers and partner teams build into production
Combine evidence across engagements into platform requirements, turn proven approaches into patterns other teams reuse, and coach architects and engineers so they deliver without you

A day in the life

You start with a reliability engineer reviewing an issue that recurred across three builds, and you map where the evidence lives in test, quality, and telemetry data. Midday, you demo two prototypes, one retrieval-based and one agent-based, that gather that evidence and draft a root-cause hypothesis with citations, and the team picks one against agreed-upon accuracy criteria. In the afternoon, you write the requirements a partner team needs to connect their data, and you review the architecture with the engineer who will build it for production.

About The Team

Leo Intelligence Technologies is the central AI team within Leo Satellite Build Systems. We build shared AI capabilities and applications that help Production Operations make better, faster decisions. Our work spans governed data, domain-specific language models, retrieval and knowledge services, evaluation frameworks, and agentic workflows that factory teams use every day.

Our systems directly influence manufacturing decisions, so we emphasize rigorous experimentation, strong data foundations, clear documentation, and production-ready engineering. Our solutions architects connect the teams we serve, inside and outside Production Operations, to these building blocks and prove what works before we build it.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
2+ years of experience designing or building generative AI or machine learning solutions for production applications
Experience writing working code, such as prototypes, proofs of concept, or production software, in Python or another modern programming language

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing generative AI solutions with retrieval-augmented generation, agents, fine-tuning, or evaluation frameworks for enterprise customers
Experience building proofs of concept that customers adopted into production
Experience with root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), reliability engineering, or failure analysis
Experience writing narratives, requirements, or architecture documents for senior leaders
Experience leading technical programs across organizations with competing priorities
Experience with AWS AI and data services, such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, AWS Glue, or Amazon Athena, including in regulated environments such as AWS GovCloud (US)

added.title: Amazon Connect AI Solutions Architect
added.description:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday, to work together in person, and teams can choose where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What You'll Do

You will design and build the AI capabilities that power our Amazon Connect contact center, so customers resolve more on their own and agents and supervisors spend their time where it matters most. Our team creates seamless omnichannel engagement across voice, chat, and email and increases first contact resolution through cloud contact center solutions that support both human and virtual agents. This role centers on applying the AI features of Amazon Connect to self-service, agent support, and quality management.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

Design and build AI-powered self-service:
Build contact flows, flow modules, Lex bots, and Agentic CX Designer (ACXD) flows in Amazon Connect. Configure intents, utterances, slots, and conversation states for voice and chat bots, then run unit, flow, and end-to-end testing.
Connect AI agents and keep the experience consistent:
Connect AI agents and generative AI experiences to flows and queues, with clear escalation paths and clean handoffs to human agents. Use shared contact attributes, routing rules, and error handling across voice, chat, and email.
Set guardrails and support responsible AI:
Build prompts, guardrails, and fallback logic so AI-driven interactions stay accurate, on brand, and safe. Cover data privacy, bias monitoring, and human oversight of automated decisions.
Implement and tune AI-assisted agent features:
Cover real-time recommendations, knowledge base retrieval, contact summarization, and automated after-contact work. Build the knowledge content, integrations, and agent workspace experiences these features depend on, and use agent feedback and usage data to improve adoption.
Build and operate AI-assisted quality management:
Set up evaluation forms, automated contact evaluation, and conversational analytics in Amazon Connect, plus sentiment analysis, categorization, and rules that surface compliance risks, coaching opportunities, and emerging customer issues. Partner with operations and quality teams to align criteria with business and regulatory standards, and measure the accuracy of AI-generated evaluations against human review.
Develop integrations and platform configuration:
Integrate with AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB, API Gateway, and third-party CRM and ticketing systems, and support core configuration including queues, routing profiles, hours of operation, and security profiles.
Monitor AI performance:
Use Amazon Connect analytics and CloudWatch to track containment, resolution, handle time, and quality outcomes, and recommend improvements. Troubleshoot technical issues and support releases and production incidents.
Partner on scope, requirements, and priorities:
Work with Program and Product Managers to scope feasibility, prioritize enhancements, and recommend platform optimizations. Translate business requirements from operations and CX teams into clear technical designs, with guidance from senior architects.
Work with vendors and evaluate new technology:
Work directly with vendor partners to influence product roadmaps, rollouts, and timelines, and evaluate new CCaaS and AI technologies to help the team make informed decisions on tools and approaches.
Document and keep learning:
Maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and integration workflows, and stay current on Amazon Connect, AWS AI services, and industry trends.

What You'll Bring

BA/BS preferred in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
4-6 years of experience with Amazon Connect, designing and implementing features and writing technical documentation.
Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect's AI capabilities, such as Amazon Lex, generative AI and AI agents, agent assist, conversational analytics, and automated quality evaluation, including prompt design, intent modeling, and escalation handling.
Experience with APIs and web services, plus working knowledge of AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and API Gateway.
Understanding of AI and large language model best practices, including prompt engineering, grounding with knowledge sources, evaluation of AI output, and responsible AI, plus familiarity with contact center quality metrics such as containment, first contact resolution, and handle time.
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies and best practices for QA and regression testing.
A proactive, analytical self-starter who learns quickly, makes data-driven decisions, manages multiple projects, and works comfortably across cultures, locations, and time zones.

What Values You'll Share

Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
No Ego - Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.

What We Offer

A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.

The target annual base pay range for this role is $121,900 - $162,500

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com .

added.description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk.
