About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Design, develop, deploy, and support artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that improve products, services, and business processes across the organization. Leverage advanced AI engineering, cloud-native development, and software engineering practices to deliver scalable, secure, and responsible AI applications and platforms.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Design, develop, deploy, and support AI applications, automation solutions, and digital agents.
Deliver generative AI (Gen AI) and agentic solutions using established frameworks and cloud technologies.
Apply software engineering with best practices to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable AI solutions.
Support the full AI solution lifecycle from design through production support.
Contribute to the enhancement, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI platforms and services.
Improve AI products, engineering processes, and technical standards through the application of best practices.
Support platform reliability, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead small projects or technical workstreams and help ensure successful delivery.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers through coaching and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate with business, architecture, security, and platform teams to deliver AI solutions and communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or related field
Eight years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or related disciplines
Two years of experience in end-to-end AI solution design, development, testing, monitoring, and maintenance

added.description:
At Provectus
, you don't prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude + AWS system into their real, regulated production. Then you watch the business number move. We're a Premier AWS Partner
and a preferred partner in Anthropic's partner network
. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter, without the layers, politics, and long wait for impact of a firm with a hundred thousand people. 400+ people, 100+ customers in production, led by our founders since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA.

We're building this team around New York and the Bay Area. There's no enforced in-office policy, but you need to be close enough to come in on short notice, and every engagement opens with two to four weeks on site with the client.

Why Provectus?

Frontier access. Anthropic Preferred Partner: newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems.
Real tasks (not scope), real deployment. You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive.
Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process, not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff augmentation.
Autonomous. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.
Your experience stays portable. Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy maintenance grind, not a single stack.
Craft & growth. Build beside senior FDEs on a Claude certified team, with a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name.
We give you a stage: Claude certification, conference talks, open source contributions, published work under your own name.

What you’ll do:

Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive. You are the one who builds it
Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously
You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints, working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it
Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice

What we look for:

Typically 7+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands on today and intend to stay that way
Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly
Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production, not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works
You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a nondeterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why
Strong engineering fundamentals. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack
Cloud native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits
Presales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders: you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job
Hands on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses)

Nice to have:

Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production
IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform
Open source contributions or public writing on applied AI

What We Offer:

Full time
On site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC once a week
Unlimited Vacation policy
Generous health, vision, and dental insurance
401(k) matching plan
Base salary $180k to $250k + bonuses; OTE up to $300k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data
No Visa sponsorship

We’re real:

A person reads your application. We filter out AI generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team
We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates
You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We’d be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Cofounder & CEO

How we hire:

Recruitment interview.
Tech interview with our FDE (30 min).
A live engineering building session (1.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.
Soft skills interview.
Offer discussion.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

added.description:
R242057

Job Profile

Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As Agentic Engineer Senior within PNC's Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA.

As a Agentic Engineer Senior, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced AI agents and Generative AI applications that automate complex workflows and enhance productivity across the organization. You will partner closely with data scientists, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable AI solutions capable of solving real-world business problems.

This role will focus on building agentic AI systems that leverage large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration frameworks, enterprise data platforms, and API-based integrations.

In addition to solution development, you will oversee production AI systems, establish monitoring and observability standards, analyze telemetry and performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. You will act as a technical leader and subject matter expert within the team, helping guide architectural decisions and mentoring fellow engineers.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise-scale AI agents and GenAI applications.
Lead the architecture and implementation of agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain.
Develop scalable software solutions that integrate LLMs, internal systems, data platforms, and external services.
Build and maintain API-driven integrations utilizing REST services and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations.
Design AI-powered automation solutions that improve business processes and data engineering workflows.
Partner with data scientists to operationalize AI solutions and measure business impact through performance metrics and business outcomes.
Establish best practices for AI application development, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Utilize observability and telemetry data to evaluate AI agent performance, identify optimization opportunities, and enhance solution reliability.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues while ensuring platform stability and scalability.
Lead code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to technical standards across the team.
Collaborate with architecture, security, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovative approaches to advance the organization's AI capabilities.

Key Qualifications & Experience

Software engineering experience, including experience delivering complex technology solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Python development.
Experience designing and deploying Generative AI, machine learning, or LLM-based applications in production environments.
Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph and/or LangChain.
Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and distributed services.
Experience implementing AI tools and integrations utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar AI integration frameworks.
Experience supporting production systems and driving operational excellence through monitoring, telemetry, and observability practices.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and influence engineering direction.
Experience building agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or multi-agent architectures.
Experience developing solutions utilizing PySpark and modern data engineering platforms.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI application architecture.
Experience with cloud-based AI and data platforms.
Experience implementing AI observability, evaluation frameworks, and performance monitoring solutions.
Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, and AI governance frameworks.
Experience working within large enterprise environments.
Financial services industry experience is preferred.

PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

As a Agentic Engineer Senior within PNC's technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA.

Designs, develops, deploys, and optimizes agentic AI solutions that address complex business needs and improve operational effectiveness.
Collaborates with stakeholders to analyze workflows, define requirements and success measures, and determine where autonomous or human-in-the-loop agent capabilities are appropriate.
Develops multi-step agent workflows, tool integrations, retrieval patterns, memory approaches, and evaluation methods that support scalable and secure solutions.
Identifies and resolves issues involving agent behavior, orchestration, data access, performance, controls, and user adoption while supporting ongoing production improvement.
Applies knowledge of agentic architectures, software development, AI risk, and business processes to deliver reliable and sustainable solutions.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

Customer Focused: Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
Managing Risk: Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Competencies

Business Acumen, Business Process Improvement, Client Relationship Management, Consulting, Intelligent Solution Development, Problem Solving, Requirements Analysis, System and Technology Integration

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. Bachelors

No Required or Preferred Language Assessments

added.description:
Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.

Health & Wellness benefits starting on day 1 of employment

Paid parental leave

401K eligibility

Tuition reimbursement

Employee Assistance Program eligibility / Health Advocate

Paid vacation and Paid holidays

Job Description

We are seeking an exceptionally talented and entrepreneurial AI engineer to build next-generation Artificial Intelligence capabilities that transform how scientific knowledge is accessed, interpreted, synthesized, and applied across global R&D.

This is a fast-moving, highly exploratory role within the Materials Science & Characterization (MSC) organization, operating as an AI skunk works focused on developing custom AI systems and intelligent applications for scientific and engineering challenges.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of advanced AI architectures, large language models (LLMs), information retrieval, knowledge engineering, and scientific computing. A central part of the mission will be to develop sophisticated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures that connect LLMs to proprietary scientific databases, experimental datasets, technical literature, patents, and internal knowledge repositories.

Beyond conventional LLM applications, the candidate will explore and build custom solutions using LLMs, multimodal language models, and small language models (SLMs), along with agentic architectures capable of reasoning, retrieving information, orchestrating computational tools, and executing complex scientific workflows.

We are looking for someone who thrives on experimentation, moves rapidly from concepts to working prototypes, and has the technical depth to build custom AI solutions rather than simply assemble existing tools. The opportunity is to establish entirely new ways of leveraging scientific knowledge and computational intelligence to accelerate innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced LLM and RAG Architectures

Design, develop, and implement advanced RAG architectures connecting LLMs to complex scientific and engineering databases.

Explore and develop hybrid, graph-based, hierarchical, multimodal, and agentic RAG approaches.

Build sophisticated retrieval, reranking, embedding, and context-engineering pipelines to improve accuracy, relevance, and scientific grounding.

Develop mechanisms for source attribution, traceability, provenance, and reliable retrieval of scientific information.

Integrate structured and unstructured data sources, including scientific databases, technical reports, patents, publications, experimental datasets, and engineering documentation.

Custom AI Models and Intelligent Agents

Develop, fine-tune, adapt, and deploy custom LLMs, multimodal models, and SLMs for specialized scientific and engineering applications.

Build agentic AI systems capable of multi-step reasoning, information retrieval, data analysis, and computational task execution.

Develop multi-agent architectures that coordinate specialized tools, models, and scientific workflows.

Explore emerging model architectures, orchestration frameworks, and AI development paradigms to identify opportunities for competitive differentiation.

Evaluate open-source and commercial foundation models and determine optimal architectures for specific scientific applications.

Scientific Knowledge Engineering

Develop intelligent interfaces and knowledge systems that make complex scientific databases accessible through natural language and semantic search.

Build knowledge graphs, scientific ontologies, and semantic representations connecting materials, formulations, processes, structures, properties, and performance.

Develop pipelines for extracting and structuring scientific information from heterogeneous sources, including complex documents, tables, figures, and experimental records.

Establish robust approaches for data preparation, indexing, metadata management, and continuous knowledge integration.

AI Application Development and Rapid Prototyping

Rapidly conceptualize, prototype, and demonstrate novel AI applications addressing high-value scientific and engineering challenges.

Develop custom AI tools and applications using modern software engineering, model orchestration, and deployment frameworks.

Integrate LLMs with scientific databases, Python-based computational tools, simulation platforms, and analytical workflows.

Explore emerging technologies and translate promising concepts into practical, working applications.

Establish evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy, retrieval quality, hallucination rates, reliability, security, and practical utility.

Collaboration and Innovation Across R&D

Work closely with materials scientists, computational scientists, experimentalists, and engineers to identify opportunities for AI-enabled scientific discovery.

Translate complex scientific problems into computational architectures and working AI solutions.

Help establish new capabilities and technical standards for the responsible deployment of AI across R&D.

Stay at the forefront of developments in LLMs, agentic AI, multimodal systems, and scientific AI.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

Candidates from engineering disciplines will also be considered with exceptional computer science foundations and demonstrated AI engineering expertise.

Strong programming and software development skills, particularly in Python.

Demonstrated experience developing and implementing LLM-based applications, including RAG architectures.

Strong understanding of modern machine learning, deep learning, transformer architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and information retrieval.

Experience with modern AI development frameworks and tools, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.

Experience working with APIs, databases, data pipelines, and software integration.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical computational solutions.

Ability to work independently as well as in a diverse cross-functional team, experiment rapidly, and develop working prototypes with minimal supervision.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

Advanced RAG architectures, including Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, and multimodal RAG.

Fine-tuning and customization of open-source LLMs and SLMs.

Multi-agent systems and intelligent AI orchestration.

Knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic search, and scientific knowledge representation.

Vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures.

Model evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization.

Multimodal AI involving technical documents, scientific images, tables, and structured/unstructured data.

AI application development, deployment, and scalable software architectures.

Integration of AI systems with scientific computing, simulation, and engineering tools. Experience in scientific, engineering, or industrial applications is particularly valuable.

Less than 10% travel expected.

Position Summary...Role summary: Merchandising Data Science builds automated decision engines and decision support systems for merchandising decisions, nearly all of which start with a demand forecast. As a Principal Data Scientist, you take on questions no one team owns because the answer spans steps — estimating demand from stockout-censored, promotion-distorted sales, forecasting it with calibrated uncertainty, and setting inventory targets. An early mistake degrades every later step, so they must be designed together. You set technical direction, hand pieces to Senior DS, personally build the hardest ones, and stay accountable for the whole. This is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports. About the team: At Sam's Club, millions of members trust us to deliver a seamless, high-value shopping experience. Behind it is one of the world's largest commerce ecosystems. As a Principal Data Scientist on the Demand Forecasting team within Merchandising Data Science, you will turn billions of data points into forecasting and decision systems that predict demand, set inventory targets, and keep products in stock. You'll work through Senior Data Scientists and partner with engineers, planners, merchants, and business leaders to drive decisions at scale. If you're energized by solving complex, ambiguous problems and putting models into production, we want you.

What you'll do...What you'll do:

Formulate layered decision chains — demand sensing → forecasting → inventory targets — with objectives, constraints, fallbacks, and success criteria for each step and the whole chain.
Set technical direction for forecasting: hierarchical, probabilistic, multi-horizon models.
Solve promotions, new items, intermittent demand, and stockout-censored demand.
Decide between automated engines, decision support, or a mix.
Decompose problems for Senior DS; personally build the hardest, most coupled pieces.
Own modeling tradeoffs across the whole system.
Resolve cross-team conflicts with data and math.
Define end-to-end, decision-linked evaluation frameworks.
Set standards for monitoring, drift detection, and root-cause analysis.
Use AI-accelerated development without lowering the correctness bar.

What you'll bring:

Shipped systems, automated or decision-support, that moved a business metric such as forecast accuracy, in-stock rate, or waste.
Deep expertise in time series forecasting at scale: hierarchical, probabilistic, gradient-boosted, and deep learning methods.
Causal measurement of promotion, price, and cannibalization effects; new-item and censored-demand modeling.
Experience designing layered decision chains — demand to forecast to inventory targets — where errors compound downstream.
Working knowledge of inventory and optimization methods, and judgment on automation versus human decisions.
Rigorous evaluation and data validation; skill navigating competing team incentives without authority.
Senior IC; no people-management background expected.

added.title: Applied Scientist II, Performance Algorithms
added.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

The Trade Desk is a global technology company with a mission to create a better, more open internet for everyone through principled, intelligent advertising. Handling over 1 trillion queries per day, our platform operates at an unprecedented scale. We have also built something even stronger and more valuable: an award-winning culture based on trust, ownership, empathy, and collaboration. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Do you have a passion for solving hard problems at scale? Are you eager to join a dynamic, globally-connected team where your contributions will make a meaningful difference in building a better media ecosystem? Come and see why Fortune magazine consistently ranks The Trade Desk among the best small-medium-sized workplaces globally.

About The Role

Our team is responsible for developing algorithms that run in our real time bidding platform with the ultimate goal of helping thousands of customers run effective advertising campaigns. Many of our problems involve getting deep learning algorithms to train and inference at scale. Some of the challenges include sparse and/or noisy labels and data, large output space (thousands of labels), millisecond latency requirements, high QPS requirements (thousands or millions per second), and unreliable ground truth.

Applied Scientists on our team work closely with engineering throughout the lifecycle of the product, from ideation to productionalization and monitoring.

Our Applied Scientists are end-to-end owners. You will participate actively in all aspects of designing, researching, building, and delivering data-focused products for our clients.

We are a team built on a foundation of generosity and openness, and we expect our data scientists to help make others better and raise the bar for those around them. As a Data Scientist, you will contribute meaningfully through leading others.

Who We Are Looking For

You have a sustained track record of making significant,self-directed, and end-to-end contributions to complex, multi-layered, impactful machine learning
You think beyond just the task at hand to deeply understand the 'why' behind what you are doing and anticipate problems that may be several degrees removed from obvious requirements.
You make your team better by proactively advocating for and driving improvements not just to what the team produces, but also the ways in which the team works.
You have a strong sense of data intuition. At our scale, many off-the-shelf modeling techniques (open source and enterprise) simply don't work. You are able to work from first principles to develop solutions and adapt them to a unique environment.
You are a broadly skilled data scientist with deep expertise working with embedded models in always-onproduction systems and working across a variety of technologies and data sources.
You have a product-focused mindset. You have the passion and ability to contribute to the process of discovering what will delight our clients and push forward one of the world’s largest and most influential industries toward a vision of openness, transparency, and evidence-based decision-making.
You work with confidence and without ego. Our data scientists have deep knowledge and exercise a high degree of leadership in their daily work. You have strongly-held, defensible ideas, and advocate for what you believe is right. You are also adept at identifying andevaluating trade-offs, willing to be proven wrong, and quick to support your fellow teammates.
You value, seek out, and foster diversity. We are a global team from many diverse backgrounds, with different experiences and perspectives. To complement this team, you will welcome ideas that are different from your own and be skilled at finding and building from common ground.
You are a creative thinker, not bound by "the way things have always been done." What you know is less important than how well you learn and innovate. We don't need data scientists who know all the answers; we need data scientists who can invent the answers no one has thought of yet, to the questions yet to be asked.
You have an abundance of intellectual curiosity and are enthusiastic to learn (and teach) new technologies / techniques.
You are you comfortable working on an agile, distributed team spanning multiple time zones and continents.
You are able to communicate effectively across both technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring To The Table

We do not expect you to know every technology we use when you start at TTD. What we care most about is that you can learn quickly and solve complex problems using the best tools for the job. However, we find that the most successful candidates typically come in with something like the following experience:

BS/MS in Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with 3+ years of full-time industry experience, or a PhD with 2+ years of full-time industry experience, in a role that involves bringing products from ideation to production.
Experience in deep learning, Pytoch preferred.
Experience running heavy workloads on a distributed computing cluster (especially EMR or Databricks), leveraging technologies like Spark to work with large datasets is preferred
Proficient in Python, Scala, and SQL; hands-on experience with Spark, EMR and Ray.
Proficient in software engineering concepts like containerization and version control is preferred.
Experience with ads, recommendation systems or KPI optimization modeling is a plus; large-scale advertising platforms and lift modeling (conversion lift, brand lift) experience strongly preferred.

added.description:
Work Your Magic with us! Start your next chapter and join MilliporeSigma.

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Your Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist, Product Content to sit at the intersection of scientific data engineering, product ownership, and eCommerce merchandising strategy. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role for someone equally at home writing Python pipelines, applying cheminformatics methods to a chemical catalog, and shaping the roadmap for next-generation PIM capabilities.

You will serve as both the technical and product owner for the systems, standards, and scientific methods that govern how MilliporeSigma's Life Science catalog is enriched, governed, and delivered to customers across our eCommerce channels, building a working understanding of the application infrastructure that powers them along the way.

What You Will Do

Scientific Data Enrichment
Build and maintain pipelines to enrich product records with physicochemical properties, biological activity data, and supplier information, sourced from PubChem, UniProt, vendor-supplied catalogs and other databases
Apply cheminformatics (RDKit, SMILES/InChI, structure-activity relationships) and bioinformatics methods to derive, validate, and standardize chemical and biological product attributes at scale
Author customer-benefit statements that translate complex molecular and biochemical properties into commercially relevant, customer-facing language

Data Engineering & Tooling
Design, build, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines in Python (or SQL as needed), and pipeline builder
Develop internal dashboards, lightweight applications, and automation scripts to accelerate data curation and monitor content quality

PIM Ownership & Data Governance
Act as technical and product owner for product data quality initiatives: data models, attribute schemas, validation rules, and enrichment workflows
Define and maintain product taxonomy hierarchies and data syndication rules for B2B portals, digital marketing channels, and internal systems
Drive governance standards for completeness, accuracy, and consistency

eCommerce Product Collaboration
Define requirements for new PIM capabilities, translating data constraints and customer behavior into impact-quantified asks for the engineering roadmap
Build infrastructure literacy, including eCommerce APIs, search indexing, and content delivery architecture, to identify what merchandising improvements are technically feasible and advocate for the platform investments needed to unlock them

Who You Are

Minimum Qualification

Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline
At least 5 years in a product data, data science, data engineering, or scientific informatics role
Production-quality experience with cloud-native data warehouses (Foundry, BigQuery)
Hands-on experience with cheminformatics or bioinformatics workflows and programmatic access to PubChem, PubMed/NCBI, ChEMBL, UniProt, or equivalent
Experience working within a PIM system in a data modeling or enrichment capacity
Demonstrated ability to own technical projects and effectively communicate findings

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Data Science or a related discipline
Familiarity with eCommerce search infrastructure (Elasticsearch, Solr) and how product attributes influence findability
Experience building lightweight internal applications or APIs
Working knowledge of GHS/SDS data structures
Exposure to CI/CD, containerization, and cloud platforms

Why This Role

High ownership over projects that directly affect how scientists worldwide find and evaluate products on one of the world's largest scientific eCommerce platforms. Rare intersection of scientific domain expertise, hands-on data engineering, and eCommerce product strategy, with the latitude to build pipelines, tools, and frameworks from the ground up, and grow your understanding of the platform infrastructure that serves them.

Location

This position is required to be site based in either our Burlington, MA or St. Louis, MO office. We do offer a hybrid flexible work arrangement.

added.title: Computational Mechanics Research Engineer
added.description:
ARCTOS Technology Solutions, a DCS company, is seeking a highly motivated computational research engineer to join our team supporting the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL). This role focuses on the development and implementation of advanced hybrid Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Machine Learning (ML) software frameworks to enhance predictive modeling capabilities for advanced materials and structural systems. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of computational solid mechanics, data-driven modeling, and high-performance computing. Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering and research team in collaboration with government and academic partners, you will implement advanced modeling solutions in distributed GPU and parallel computing environments.

Essential Job Functions

Design, extend, and implement modular software architectures that blend traditional finite element methods with machine learning models and efficient numerical algorithms.

Develop and integrate machine-learned crack initiation and path prediction models using experimental data, mapping sub-mesh resolution microstructural information and stress fields to fracture behaviors.

Formulate and deploy physics-based solvers and contact mechanics algorithms for complex material systems (such as textiles and dry-fiber architectures), leveraging distributed GPU computing and MPI parallelism

Required Skills

U.S. Citizenship is required.

Ph.D. and 2+ years of experience in Computational Mechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Materials Science, or a closely related discipline.

Strong working knowledge of solid mechanics, constitutive modeling, and finite element formulation.

Familiarity with dry-fiber/textile mechanics and multiscale material modeling.

Proficiency in scientific Python programming and numerical algorithms, with experience in modern differentiable programming or machine learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch).

Demonstrated ability to write clean, modular, and well-documented research code, coordinate with external academic and laboratory partners, and author technical reports and presentations.

Desired Skills

Direct experience developing or extending finite element libraries, utilizing high-performance computing frameworks, or implementing distributed MPI/GPU computing architectures.

Experience implementing regularized extended finite element methods, advanced enrichment techniques, or coarse-grained contact solvers.

Proven experience training and deploying machine learning models on experimental characterization data to predict mechanical response and structural life limits.

added.description:
Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?

At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

Rincon Research Corporation (RRC), an employee-owned company, is seeking an AI/ML Engineer to support the design, development, integration, testing, and deployment of solutions that address complex mission and operational needs. This role will have a particular focus on the integration and application of emerging artificial intelligence technologies, including large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI capabilities, within existing and future software systems. The successful candidate will bring strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience developing AI and agent-based technologies to real-world mission challenges. This individual will work across the development lifecycle—from architecture and rapid prototyping through integration, testing, containerization, deployment, and operational support. The AI/ML Engineer will collaborate with brilliant computer scientists, electrical engineers, and mathematicians in an R&D environment where technical excellence is the standard.

Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

What are the primary responsibilities in the AI/ML Engineer position?

Design and architect AI solutions that process real-world data
Build robust, secure systems that operate in challenging environments
Explore and integrate LLMs, AI-enabled services, and agentic capabilities into software applications where they provide mission value.
Develop AI-enabled workflows that may incorporate model APIs, tool/function calling, retrieval, data sources, external services, and multi-step processing.
Evaluate and test AI-enabled capabilities for functionality, reliability, performance, and appropriate behavior.
Apply sound software engineering principles, including modular design, code reuse, version control, automated testing, documentation, and peer review.
Integrate software with APIs, databases, data platforms, enterprise services, mission systems, and third-party technologies.
Develop and maintain unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across application code, integrations, containers, infrastructure, and external dependencies.
Collaborate directly with engineers, program teams, and government customers to understand mission requirements and translate them into working software.
Stay current with emerging software and AI technologies and identify practical opportunities to incorporate them into mission solutions.

What required background will make you successful?

Degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related technical field.
Experience applying emerging AI technologies, including LLMs and agent-based software patterns.
Experience with LLM APIs and platforms and integrating model capabilities into production software.
Familiarity with techniques for testing and evaluating nondeterministic AI/LLM applications, including evaluation datasets, tracing, observability, and failure analysis.
Proficiency in Python, including experience developing production-quality applications, services, or backend systems.
Experience with one or more additional programming languages such as C/C++, Java, or GoLang.

added.title: Founding AI Engineer
added.description:
Found AI Engineer, Obol

Reports to the CEO · Austin, Texas, on the floor · Hybrid

About the Company

Zengistics is a freight brokerage in Austin where AI agents work the floor from quote to cash, alongside brokers who keep the relationships, the judgment and the upside. It is working: revenue is up 118% year over year.

Brokerage is two jobs. AI does one. People do the other. We are hiring the person who wires them together.

What is Obol:
The AI platform Zengistics is building.

Obol is the AI platform Zengistics is building. It is our own product and our own IP. It brings our shippers, our carriers and our own team onto one platform, and uses AI to make freight work better for all three. We are building it in-house and proving it on our own freight first.

Our AI partner's agents are the system of action: they plug into our transportation management system and do the work. Obol is the system of interaction that sits on top. At its core is a scoring and incentive engine. Freight runs on hundreds of small transactions a day, and Obol scores every one of them, shows our team, our carriers and our shippers where they stand, and rewards them for reaching the next tier with faster payment, better terms or higher commission.

The Role:
Our first engineering hire. You build the platform.

Obol has a thesis, a design and a live brokerage floor to prove it on. You turn the design into working software, put it in front of the people who use it, measure what it does, and ship again the next week. You also help decide how it gets built: we want your view on the right stack and the right way to build it.

• Build Obol's core: data model, services, and the interfaces our team, carriers and shippers use. Interfaces roll out in phases: functional for our team first, then our carriers, then a polished experience for our shippers.
• Build the scoring and incentive engine at the heart of Obol: score every interaction, show progress, recommend the next tier.
• Connect it to what runs our floor today: our transportation management system (Turvo), the tools wired into it, and our AI partner's agents.
• Put AI to work inside the platform, with evals and guardrails built in from the start.
• Instrument everything. Every feature ships with a metric and an owner.
• Lead the technical side of our partner and vendor relationships: roadmap, priorities, accountability.
• Spend time on the floor. Listen to carrier calls. Ask the reps what to build next.

Who You Are:
A builder who lives in AI

• 0–5 years of hands-on software experience. Side projects, open source and personal builds count as much as a job title. Show us what you have built.
• Full-stack and pragmatic: Python or TypeScript, SQL and data modeling, REST, webhooks and event pipelines, cloud basics. Comfortable building with LLM tool-use and agent frameworks, and clear-eyed about where they break.
• You have built something real that people use, ideally at a startup or in a hands-on role where you built next to the people using it.
• A doer and a self-starter. You would rather show a prototype than write a memo. You say "here's how" before "here's why not."
• You think in scores, incentives and progress. Experience with gamification, rewards or loyalty systems is a plus.
• Freight experience is an accelerator, and so is time in TMS APIs (ours is Turvo). Neither is required; curiosity about both is.
• Data-literate enough to own a scorecard: define a metric, pipe it, defend it to the people it measures.
• Low ego with partners, high standards with yourself. Comfortable with ambiguity, allergic to drift.
• Based in Austin or willing to relocate. Some travel.

First 90 Days

• Days 1–30: Live on the floor. Map how a load moves through our systems, quote to cash. Own the metrics pipeline.
• Days 31–60: Stand up Obol's foundation: the data model, the integrations, the first scorecard.
• Days 61–90: Ship the first piece of Obol to real users on real freight, and measure what it does.

Beyond the first 90 days, the goal is Obol live, in daily use and driving real value by the end of next summer.

What we offer:
A real floor, real freight, real numbers

• Competitive base for the Austin market, plus a 20–25% bonus target on top.
• Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, and life insurance.
• Hybrid in Austin: on the floor Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday.
• A $64M run-rate brokerage as your lab, owned by the McCaig Family Office, owners of Trimac.
• A direct line to the CEO, and daily work with our VP Strategy and our AI partner.
• Scope that grows as the platform does.

Zengistics is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on what you have built and how you work.

Additional Job Application Terms

This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.

We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.

added.title: AI Engineer
added.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Solutions Architecture (SA) organization helps Stripe's most strategic customers design and validate technical solutions that drive their business forward. Within SA, our team builds the tools, workflows, and custom technical assets that make the broader SA org more effective—turning individual ingenuity into org-wide capability.

We are looking for AI Engineers who are energized by working close to the business and the users we serve. You'll operate as an embedded, high-context engineer focused on the highest-leverage opportunities across the SA org—building production-quality tooling, supporting our most strategic engagements, and shipping automation that meaningfully improves how Solutions Architects work every day.

What You'll Do

As an AI Engineer, you'll be embedded directly with the Solutions Architecture team—building alongside them, deeply understanding their workflows, and shipping tools and automation that permanently change how they operate. Your measure of success is SA productivity: the engagements you've accelerated, the workflows you've transformed, and the tools you've built that the org adopts as default.

You'll ship code daily. You'll discover where SAs lose time and build high-impact solutions. You'll take what works for one person and scale it to work for the org. And when our most strategic customer engagements need custom technical assets, you'll build those too.

This is a role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of engineering and business impact—close to customers, close to revenue, and building for people you can see using your work every day.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Solutions Architects, SA leadership, Product, and Engineering to scope technical work and translate ambiguous business needs into well-defined deliverables
Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities (LLMs, agents, workflow automation) where they provide genuine leverage—not for novelty, but for measurable productivity improvement
Architect and build internal tools, agents, and automated workflows that accelerate SA and manager productivity across technical discovery, solution design, demoing, user engagements, territory/pipeline management, and product interlock
Take high-potential tools and workflows built by SAs and managers and harden them into scalable, maintainable, production-grade solutions
Identify patterns across SA workflows and proactively build solutions that address recurring friction
Build custom demo environments, PoC applications, and technical assets for Stripe's most strategic customer engagements
Document tools, architectures, and usage patterns so others can adopt and extend what you've built
Debug, extend, and maintain backend systems across a variety of codebases and infrastructure

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of experience as an engineer shipping production systems
Strong backend engineering fundamentals: you can debug a failing system, trace issues across services, and reason about data flows
Experience building and deploying AI agents, LLM-powered tools, or workflow automation beyond basic prompt engineering
Experience scoping and delivering work with minimal oversight in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment
Proficiency in at least two of: Ruby, Node.js, Python, or Next.js
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) including deployment, monitoring, and basic DevOps
Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or workflow automation
Demonstrated ability to work across multiple codebases and technology stacks simultaneously
Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools in your engineering workflow—you're fluent with AI-assisted development but not dependent on it; you can reason through problems and debug without AI as a crutch
Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders and navigate cross-functional collaboration naturally
Comfort with ambiguity—you can take a loosely-defined business problem, scope the engineering work, and ship iteratively without waiting for a perfect spec

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing systems that non-engineers can build on top of or extend themselves (e.g., platforms, low-code frameworks, template systems)
Experience in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or GTM Engineering role—or a product engineering role where you worked closely with customers or go-to-market teams
Familiarity with Stripe's products, APIs, or the payments/fintech domain
Experience integrating with third-party platforms (Salesforce, Gong, etc.)
Track record of building tools or systems that were adopted beyond your immediate team
Background in consulting, professional services, or other roles that blend technical depth with business context

Who You Are

Beyond the technical requirements, we're looking for a specific kind of engineer:

You want to be close to the business. You're energized by seeing your work directly impact how a sales team wins a deal or how a customer succeeds.
You're a pragmatic builder. You ship working solutions quickly, iterate based on real usage, and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later." You'd rather show a working prototype today than present a roadmap deck next quarter.
You're a software engineer by practice. You can architect systems, debug production issues, write clean code, and reason about tradeoffs. AI is a tool in your belt, not a substitute for engineering judgment.
You're a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it generalizes. You think in reusable systems, not one-off scripts.
You thrive without a traditional product team structure. No PRDs landing in your lap, no dedicated PM, no sprint ceremonies. You identify the highest-leverage problem, scope the work, and ship it. You're comfortable trading on-call rotations and rigid processes for autonomy and impact.
You're a strong communicator. You can partner with SAs who are domain experts, understand their workflows deeply enough to build great tools, and explain your technical choices to leadership.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $172,600 - $258,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
added.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer

About The Department

Forward Deployed AI Engineers embed with priority Technology teams to solve real delivery problems using AI-enabled engineering practices. They work alongside developers and technical leads to improve outcomes while transferring capabilities back to the host team.

Each engagement should leave the team more capable, with reusable context, tools, and practices. The role also strengthens the broader enablement model by turning field lessons into improvements to the internal delivery-guidance product, AI PDLC, education, and reuse ecosystem.

How You Will Add Value

Embed with Technology teams in bounded engagements to identify opportunities, establish baselines, deliver against agreed outcomes, and transfer ownership.
Learn the host team’s codebase, architecture, delivery practices, data constraints, quality standards, and governance obligations.
Help teams create AI-ready context: repository and documentation evidence, team conventions, approved boundaries, decision rights, and questions requiring human escalation.
Configure and use AI workspaces, harnesses, skills, instructions, evaluation assets, and workflow patterns suited to the team’s goals.
Build or adapt agentic workflows, retrieval patterns, tools, structured outputs, evaluations, and observability practices that improve delivery without weakening quality or control.
Apply the AI PDLC across all aspects of software design and delivery.
Pair with engineers and technical leads as a constructive team member. Earn trust through useful contribution, give credit generously, and respect local expertise.
Measure outcomes such as lead time, engineering effort, rework, defects, governance exceptions, developer friction, and capacity released.
Capture proven practices and unresolved gaps; turn them into specific feedback and reusable assets for product, research, governance, education, and community partners.

What Will Help You Be Successful In This Role

The host team can continue and extend the work independently, with clearer context for its AI tools and evidence of improved productivity, quality, control, or developer experience. The engineer also improves the system beyond that team: reusable patterns are documented, product feedback is actionable, and the next engagement starts from a stronger base.

Eight to ten years of relevant experience, including leading technically complex delivery work and influencing practices beyond a single team.
Strong software engineering ability and the capacity to contribute quickly in unfamiliar codebases.
Hands-on AI engineering experience. Relevant examples include Python or TypeScript; APIs; cloud platforms; Git and CI/CD; containers; retrieval; tool use; agentic workflows; prompt and context engineering; structured outputs; and evaluation.
Ability to build and use AI harnesses: reusable instructions, skills, tools, context files, test cases, evaluation suites, traces, observability, and human-review checkpoints.
Product and business curiosity; able to distinguish a practical intervention from an attractive technical demonstration.
Analytical and communication skills: form hypotheses, establish baselines, measure outcomes, adapt based on evidence, and explain technical work clearly.
Collaborative, low-ego behavior: earns trust, gives credit, shares useful tools, and leaves teams stronger.

Preferred Experience

Forward deployment, consulting, solutions engineering, platform engineering, developer productivity, or technical product implementation.
AI evaluation, safety, monitoring, alignment, or model-risk practices.
Financial services or another regulated environment.
Reusable libraries, open-source contributions, internal tools, playbooks, technical writing, training, or community leadership.

Work Schedule & Location

This role will work a hybrid schedule, 3 days/week in the San Ramon or New York City office.

Franklin Templeton offers employees a competitive and valuable range of total rewards – monetary and non-monetary – designed to support their well-being and recognize their time, talents, and results. Along with base compensation, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, a 401(k) plan with a generous match, and recognition rewards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which includes a range of competitive healthcare options, insurance, and disability benefits, employee stock investment program, learning resources, career development programs, reimbursement for certain education expenses, paid time off (vacation / holidays / sick / leave / parental & caregiving leave / bereavement / volunteering / floating holidays) and a motivational wellbeing program. We expect the annual salary for this position to range between $190,000 – $220,000, depending on location and level of relevant experience, plus discretionary bonus.

Paid Time Off: Three weeks of PTO in your first year

Overview

Nakupuna Companies seeks a AI Forward Deployed Engineer to partner directly with users and stakeholders, identify discrete pain points, and deliver secure, practical AI-enabled solutions. This individual will lead customer discovery, define and validate requirements, develop solution concepts, and independently build and refine lightweight tools that create measurable value. The position focuses on targeted improvements such as AI agents, workflow automations, retrieval and knowledge tools, document-processing utilities, data transformations, and small integrations. The AI Engineer will coordinate with AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and application teams to ensure solutions use approved architecture, data access, and security controls.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned.

Technical Responsibilities:

Engage directly with customers and end users to understand operational pain points, clarify desired outcomes, and identify AI-enabled opportunities appropriate for rapid delivery.
Translate customer needs into concise problem statements, requirements, solution concepts, success criteria, and implementation plans.
Design, build, test, document, and deploy AI-enabled applications, agents, workflow automations, or utilities using approved development, cloud, and AI platforms.
Develop prototypes and minimum viable products that demonstrate value quickly; refine solutions using user feedback and measurable operational results.
Use Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, data stores, and approved AI services to develop maintainable solutions and small integrations.
Implement retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, prompt design, document intelligence, data transformation, and workflow automation capabilities as appropriate to the use case.
Apply sound software engineering practices, including source control, testing, documentation, peer review, and maintainable code design.
Coordinate early with technical owners when work affects production data, enterprise applications, hosting, integrations, security controls, or another team’s operational responsibilities.
Follow approved security, privacy, access-control, data-governance, and software-development requirements; identify and escalate risks, dependencies, and approval needs.
Maintain an organized pipeline of candidate use cases, solution status, risks, dependencies, user feedback, and realized value.
Create concise technical documentation, user guidance, and status updates appropriate for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Skills/Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience gathering requirements directly from customers or end users and independently translating needs into delivered technical solutions.
Hands-on experience building and deploying applications, automations, integrations, AI Agents, or data-enabled tools using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar programming languages.
Experience with generative AI, large language models, AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI-enabled workflow automation.
Working knowledge of APIs, structured and unstructured data, authentication and authorization concepts, and secure integration practices.
Strong customer engagement, communication, organizational, decision-making, and analytical skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts, delivery tradeoffs, and solution status clearly to technical teams, operational users, and senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated judgment in recognizing risks, data limitations, technical dependencies, and situations that require coordination or escalation.
Familiarity with cloud environments, cybersecurity requirements, and secure software-development practices in a regulated environment.
Ability to adapt to a dynamic, fast-paced environment and support teams across geographically dispersed locations.
Ability to re-imagine business processes leveraging Lean 6 Sigma concepts like Value Stream Analysis.

Education/Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field from an accredited institution, or equivalent years of related work or military experience.

Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, automation engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

Experience delivering AI or automation solutions in a federal, defense, regulated, or other high-security environment preferred.
Experience with AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud platforms and managed AI services preferred.
Experience using Agile methodologies and ticketing systems such as Jira is desirable.

Certification:

Required:
Active IAT II certification, which may include CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CASP+, or CISSP.
Preferred:
Cloud or AI certification, such as AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable certification.

Clearance Requirements:
Active Top Secret clearance preferred. Candidates with an active Secret clearance who are eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance will be considered. Must be a U.S. citizen.

Work Location:

Position is based in Arlington, Virginia.
The ideal candidate will work on-site approximately three (3) days per week to facilitate direct engagement with customer stakeholders, decision forums, technical teams, and solution-delivery activities.
Other work arrangements may be considered for the right candidate, based on contract requirements and customer needs.
Occasional travel may be required to support customer engagement, planning, or solution-delivery activities.
This position may require work outside normal business hours, including evenings and weekends, to meet operational or project demands.

Physical Requirements:
The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation:

Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals
added.description:
About David AI

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

About This Role

We're building David AI's first Forward Deployed Evals
team. Voice models can only improve on what someone can measure, and most of what matters in voice has never been measured well. This team finds those gaps with our customers and builds the evals to close them.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals
, you'll be the primary partner to a set of customers' research teams. In a typical week, you might spot a regression in the latest model checkpoint and design a targeted eval for it, build it end-to-end, calibrate findings against human ratings, and follow through to ensure the model improves.

This is a builder role that is intentionally cross-functional, requiring you to be capable across GTM, Ops, Product, Research, and Engineering to deliver on outcomes.

In this role, you will

Be the evaluation partner to research teams at the world's leading AI labs: learn what they're trying to fix in their voice models, and find what they haven't thought to measure yet.
Dig into human and automated eval results, pin down exactly where and why a model fails, and decide which failures deserve a dedicated eval.
Go from idea to working eval in days, independently building whatever the problem calls for: human data pipelines, detectors trained on human labels, or synthetic test harnesses.
Make every number defensible: an eval you ship should track what people actually hear, and it should hold up when a senior researcher pushes on it.
Tell research leads what to focus on in their next checkpoint and why, with the data to back it up.
Productize what works, or turn it into a playbook the team can repeat.
Shape how forward deployed evals work at David AI as one of the first people on the team.

Your background looks like

2-7+ years of experience as a technical builder across engineering, product, operations, and research (we're hiring at multiple levels); this might have been as a forward deployed engineer, applied data scientist, ML engineer, product manager, management consultant, or something else entirely.
You're exceptional at building with AI agents, and you've personally built at least one ambitious thing you can walk us through in detail.
You move fast. You solve problems in days that might take someone else a month, and you own ambiguous, high-stakes work end to end.
Strong, demonstrated analytical chops: experiment design, statistics, and knowing whether a metric actually captures what you care about.
Strong customer presence: you have the credibility and clear communication to earn the trust of technical customers and senior stakeholders.
Excited to work in person in San Francisco or New York.

Bonus points if you have

Been a founder, or founding engineer/PM/etc. at a startup.
Experience with speech, audio, or voice models.
Built or published a benchmark you can share with us.
Experience working with human raters, annotation, or data-labeling workflows.
Worked at an AI data or evals company.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO.
Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
FSA & HSA access.
401k access.
Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

Visas

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers , H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Job Number: R0254128

Agentic AI Engineer

The Opportunity:

AI is moving fast and the most consequential work is happening at the intersection of autonomous systems and real-world enterprise operations. As an Agentic AI Engineer, you'll be at the front edge of that wave, designing and building cutting-edge agentic AI solutions that don't just demo well, but deploy into production, scale across enterprise environments, and operate securely in some of the most demanding mission contexts imaginable. You'll lead and energize a development team that thrives on new tools and techniques, turning emerging capabilities like multi-agent orchestration, advanced RAG pipelines, and edge-deployed models, into solutions that change how our clients operate. If you're driven by the challenge of taking AI from prototype to production and you want to do it with problems that matter, this is your role.

What You'll Work On:

Embed agentic AI capabilities into existing enterprise systems and operational workflows, including API integration, process automation, and end-user adoption.
Design and implement intelligent agent architectures that can reason, plan, and take actions.
Develop and deploy collaborative multi-agent systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols.
Build advanced RAG pipelines integrating unstructured data with Knowledge Graphs (KG) to enhance reasoning accuracy and context retention.
Fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) for specific domains and optimize them for edge device performance.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

3+ years of experience in software development
2+ years of experience working in cloud environments, including AWS and Azure, evaluating architectural tradeoffs, designing robust service-based software applications for scalable use, and using LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, PydanticAI, CrewAI, or LlamaIndex
Experience with MCP for tool integration, A2A for collaboration, RAG architecture and knowledge graphs, memory architectures for long-running agents such as episodic, semantic, and working memory patterns, and agent benchmarking frameworks such as GAIA, SWE-bench, or custom eval harnesses
Experience with tool or function calling patterns across multiple LLM providers
Experience fine-tuning LLMs or SLMs
Knowledge of modern software design patterns, including microservice design or edge computing
Ability to translate agentic AI capabilities into practical enterprise workflows, bridging the gap between technical implementation and business process adoption
Ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment and navigate ambiguity
Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
Bachelor’s degree in CS or Computer Engineering
