Experience deploying agentic systems in a production environment
Experience deploying agents on edge devices such as Android or local models
Experience integrating coding agents such as Cursor or Windsurf, into an efficient development pipeline with measured results
Experience with programming, including ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, llama.cpp, and vLLM
Experience engineering AI capabilities in on‑premises or multi‑classification environments
Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, for client engagements, client-facing project work, and business development

The role will provide technical leadership for implementation of the NFL AI Engineering Roadmap and establish reusable, secure, and operationally supportable platform capabilities for enterprise AI assistants, Microsoft Copilot, generative AI applications, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, AI-assisted software engineering, and future AI-enabled business services.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to establish enterprise standards and partner across Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Data and Business Intelligence, Digital Media, Product, Legal, Privacy, and Service Management. The position is a senior individual contributor, directly engaged in architecture, engineering, prototyping, implementation, troubleshooting, and operational readiness.

Responsibilities

a private equity owned portfolio company, is seeking an exceptionally talented, high-achieving recent graduate with a demonstrated passion for artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to help lead AI adoption and innovation within our organization.

Founded in 1949, PHI Group, Inc. is one of the world's leading helicopter services companies. The Company's primary business has been the safe and reliable transportation of personnel to, from, and among offshore platforms for customers engaged in the oil and gas exploration, development, and production industry. Although in recent years PHI has entered several new domestic and international markets, a large portion of its offshore flight operations continue to be concentrated in the Gulf of Mexico, where PHI is a leading provider of such services. Since late 1997, PHI has also provided air medical transportation for hospitals and for emergency service agencies where it operates principally as an independent provider of medical services. In addition, PHI performs helicopter maintenance and repair services, primarily to existing customers that own their own aircraft. As of July 31, 2022, PHI owned or operated 217 aircraft domestically and internationally, 110 of which were dedicated to its Oil and Gas segment and 107 of which were dedicated to its Air Medical segment.

About Q Family Office:

Established in 1994, the Q Family Office is an organization that combines a 30-year history with a deep entrepreneurial spirit. The family office currently includes a manager of a $500 million hedge fund/private investment firm, a $3 billion bank, a $400 million real estate investment firm, and a $275 million charitable foundation.

pportunity

Experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade LLM applications, including end-to-end pipelines from data ingestion through model output delivery (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI etc.).

Understanding of software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation.

Exposure to CI/CD and operationalization practices for AI systems, including model and workflow deployment, versioning, environment promotion, and release support in cloud or containerized environments.

To qualify for the role you must have

A bachelor's or master’s degree
Minimum of 2 years of related work experience applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles
Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and trade‑offs to technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including risk and compliance.
Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution.
Able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve.
Collaborative and cross‑functional, working closely with engineering, product, teams.

Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high-value AI capabilities.
Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor etc.).
Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine-tuning is appropriate versus prompt-based solutions (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, NeMo Framework etc.).
Familiarity with responsible AI principles including bias and fairness evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and explainability approaches in the financial services contexts.
Familiarity with data pipeline design for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, and quality validation.
Familiarity with cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying scalable LLM solutions (e.g. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI etc.).
Familiarity with AI-assisted software engineering tools for accelerating development, implementation, and code review practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex etc.).

Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) Engineer to own the path from a registered model to a production inference workflow, including deployment, scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback, with near-real-time and real-time scoring to follow. This position plays a key role in supporting the AI/ML Engineering department and reports to the Sr. Manager, AI/ML Engineering, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. This position has no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

Deploy and operate models in production, owning the path from registered model to inference workflow, including scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback.
Build scoring and data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing incomplete output.
Help design, build, and run near-real-time and real-time scoring workflows, an area where our approach is still being defined.
Build monitoring for both the pipeline and the model, including scoring run status, input arrival and freshness, consistency of inputs with training data, and shifts in score distribution.
Set up and tune alerting that identifies when something needs attention, from a failed run to a model that may need retraining, so that issues are found before clinicians are affected.
Write and maintain runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs so that incident response does not depend on one person.
Contribute to shared defaults that make each new model faster and safer to ship, including automated tests that run on every model or pipeline change and a consistent release process from development to production.
Enable comparison of a new model version against the current version before downstream use cases rely on it.
Provide visibility into the cost of running each model.
Partner with data scientists to move models from development to production, including addressing training/serving skew, drift, and model versioning.
Design for security and access, including secrets management, least-privilege roles, and logging that never exposes sensitive data.
Work within a Snowflake-native platform (Snowflake ML Feature Store, Model Registry, and Experiments, dbt, Python, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript services for online orchestration).

Qualifications

Education: A bachelors degree is preferred.
Experience: Typically 5 years of experience in software, data, or ML infrastructure engineering, as a guide rather than a requirement.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Required
Has put machine learning models, or comparable data products, into production and kept them running, and can describe a failure caught, a failure missed, and what changed afterward.
Has built scheduled scoring or data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing a half-empty table.
Has built monitoring and alerting covering data quality, freshness, and model behavior, and tuned it until people trusted it.
Matches the solution to the need, with experience using managed platforms and building custom components, and can explain when each was the right call.
Strong Python and strong SQL.
Comfortable with Git-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.
Understands machine learning well enough to be a real partner to data scientists, including training/serving skew, drift, model versioning, and why a model that validated well can still fail in production.
Treats security and access as part of the design, including secrets management, least-privilege roles, and logs that never leak sensitive data.
Documents work, including runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs.
Uses AI tools effectively, with foundational engineering skills sharp enough to read, audit, and debug every line independently. If an agent writes the code, remains accountable for it and can defend it.

Preferred
Experience with Snowflake, especially Snowflake ML (Feature Store, Model Registry, Snowpark), or comparable experience on another ML platform.
Experience deploying and operating services on a cloud provider such as AWS, including containers, APIs, and real-time model serving.
Experience setting up ML operations at a company or team that did not have them.
Experience in a regulated environment (healthcare, pharmacy, payer, or life sciences is ideal), including PHI under HIPAA and BAAs, access reviews, and audit trails.
Experience with observability for LLM applications.

Work Environment

Location: Columbus, OH or remote (US)
Schedule: FT
Small but growing cross-functional team with high autonomy and minimal ceremony, building new services and practices from the ground up.
Regular collaboration with data scientists and the AI/ML Engineering team to ensure alignment.
Data is PHI. HIPAA, BAAs, masking, and role-based access are daily working realities.

Key Essential Functions

Must be able to handle PHI in compliance with HIPAA, BAAs, masking requirements, and role-based access controls.
Must be able to read, audit, and debug all code, including code produced with AI tools, and be accountable for it.

added.title: Radar Research Scientist
added.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril’s Research Scientists excel at developing state-of-the art algorithms and software that solve scientific problems with real-world applications. Working in small innovative teams, our research scientists build solutions that make a difference. Our research endeavors don’t end once we’ve written a journal or conference paper describing our technology; rather, our work is complete when our technology has been deployed in mission-critical systems and our customers within government and industry are successful. As science fiction writer Arthur Clarke wrote, “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.” Therefore, Anduril is seeking talented “magicians” to join in our common struggle of expanding the boundary of what’s possible.

What You Will Do

Formulate radar sensing problems from first principles: define the question, choose assumptions and model fidelity, and establish a baseline to measure against.
Prototype algorithms in code (primarily Python) and verify that your numerical implementation is clean and correct.
Separate model error from numerical and data-processing error through controlled experiments.
Analyze real field data, including I/Q, spectra, range-Doppler maps, detections, and tracks, keeping calibration, timestamps, configuration, and truth association straight.
Validate performance with Monte Carlo analysis, bounds, sensitivity studies, and comparison of predictions against measurements.
Explain the problem, the intuition, your personal contribution, the results, and the limitations clearly to engineers.
Partner with radar algorithms engineers to carry promising research into a shipped capability

Required Qualifications

An M.S. or Ph.D. in Applied or Computational Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Controls and Dynamical Systems, Aerospace Engineering, Statistics and Probability, or a related field.
Record of academic excellence, including demonstrated experience in most of the following areas:
Applied Mathematics: differential equations, linear algebra, numerical analysis, and continuous or discrete optimization;
Engineering: controls, estimation theory, digital signal processing, and machine learning;
Scientific Computing: software design, algorithm implementation, and software analysis, testing, and optimization;
Probability: statistics and random processes.

Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the demonstrated ability to convey salient details about advanced technology in a compelling manner to both experts and non-experts alike.
Strong mathematical foundations, with strong grades in core technical coursework scaled to your degree: calculus and linear algebra and differential equations at the BS level; probability and statistics at the MS level; random processes, detection and estimation, or optimization at the PhD level.
Ability to turn an idea into clean, correct numerical code in Python and check it. (Our interview includes a Python coding assessment.)
Judgment to define a question, choose assumptions and fidelity, establish a baseline, and tell model error apart from numerical or data error. A convincing example may come from a non-radar physical or statistical system.
Clear technical communication: you can explain your work and simplify it when asked, rather than reaching for jargon.
Prior internship, co-op, research-lab, or industry experience, with work you can describe as your own.
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Formulate radar sensing problems from first principles: define the question, choose assumptions and model fidelity, and establish a baseline to measure against.
Prototype algorithms in code (primarily Python) and verify that your numerical implementation is clean and correct.
Separate model error from numerical and data-processing error through controlled experiments.
Analyze real field data, including I/Q, spectra, range-Doppler maps, detections, and tracks, keeping calibration, timestamps, configuration, and truth association straight.
Validate performance with Monte Carlo analysis, bounds, sensitivity studies, and comparison of predictions against measurements.
Explain the problem, the intuition, your personal contribution, the results, and the limitations clearly to engineers.
Partner with radar algorithms engineers to carry promising research into a shipped capability

A Note On Fit

Prior radar experience is not required, and neither is a PhD or a fixed number of years. Production C++, CUDA, or deployment expertise is a bonus. If you have strong foundations, write solid scientific code, and reason carefully about physical systems, we want to talk.

We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range

$165,000—$218,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. Description & Requirements

MaxHP is hiring a Data Scientist. The Data Scientist frames analytical questions with Government stakeholders, prepares and explores data, selects and applies appropriate methods, validates results, and communicates findings to technical and non-technical audiences through reports, briefings, and visual analytics built on the Government-furnished technology stack.

U.S. citizenship is required. Candidates must possess an active U.S. Government security clearance or be eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance as required for contract performance
. 

This position is pending upon contract award.

Candidates should be willing to support POTFF Operations at one of the following locations:
Tucson, AZ; Coronado, CA; Washington, DC; Fort Walton Beach, FL; Tampa, FL; Fayetteville, NC; Jacksonville, NC; Clovis, NM.

At MaxHP, your expertise supports a mission that matters. As a joint venture between Maximus and Endurion, MaxHP brings together specialized capabilities and resources to support the POTFF Program, strengthening human performance, resilience, and mission readiness across the Special Operations community. Our professionals play an essential role in supporting the people behind the mission, helping Service members and their families remain strong, ready, and resilient. Here, your experience becomes part of something bigger: directly supporting those who serve at the highest levels of our Nation’s defense.

About the POTFF Program:

The Preservation of the Force and Family (POTFF) program supports U.S. Special Operations Forces (SOF) personnel and their families through an integrated, holistic approach to human performance, health, and readiness. The program brings together specialized professionals across physical, psychological, cognitive, social, and spiritual performance to strengthen resilience, optimize performance, and support long-term mission readiness and career longevity.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Interpret and analyze structured and unstructured data using exploratory, statistical, and machine-learning techniques grounded in the scientific method; frame relevant problems, hypotheses, and opportunities with Government stakeholders.
Query, clean, transform, and prepare data from the Government-designated Human Performance System of Record (e.g., HPDMS) and other Government-approved sources for analysis, using the curated datasets maintained by the Data Engineer where available.
Develop, validate, and document predictive and prescriptive models, forecasting methods, clustering, and other advanced statistical techniques to generate actionable forecasts regarding operator readiness, injury risk, program efficacy, and performance optimization, as directed by the Government.
Support text-heavy use cases using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques (e.g., cleaning, entity extraction, classification) to analyze unstructured clinical or survey data, and apply Large Language Model (LLM) and agent-style workflows only within Government-approved tools and datasets.
Develop, deploy, and maintain visual analytics, dashboards, and executive reports using Government-furnished tools (e.g., Power BI, including semantic modeling and DAX), and integrate data products into low-code operational workflows (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform) where directed.
Support Government-designed analyses and experiments that measure the validity, efficacy, and Return on Investment (ROI) of POTFF interventions, including computation of program-efficacy metrics as directed by the Government.
Automate recurring analyses and the generation of required monthly and quarterly reports, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
Document data sources, transformations, assumptions, methods, and validation procedures so that analyses are reproducible and can be transferred to other personnel.
Communicate complex concepts, methods, and results clearly to non-technical command leadership and to clinical and performance staff, in writing and in briefings.
Collaborate with embedded clinical and performance staff to identify opportunities for capturing data and improving the quality of input into Government systems.

added.description:
The Department of Radiology and Medical Imaging at the University of Virginia (UVA) School of Medicine seeks applications for a Research Scientist to join its military brain health research program. Under the mentorship of James R. Stone, MD, PhD, Vice Chair for Research, the Research Scientist will help develop and carry out multidisciplinary research on the neurological consequences of occupational and environmental exposures, with particular emphasis on military populations. Areas of interest include repeated low-level blast exposure, traumatic brain injury, injury prevention, and translational research that improves the health and readiness of service members.

The Research Scientist will work closely with the Principal Investigator (PI) to design studies, prepare extramural funding proposals, coordinate multi-site research collaborations, and disseminate findings. The role involves regular interaction with investigators across the School of Medicine and the University, and with academic, government, and military partners, including Department of Defense research sponsors and national and international scientific working groups.

The successful candidate will be expected to develop research projects and to pursue extramural funding, with the goal of contributing to the growth of the department’s externally funded research portfolio.

Tasks Associated with the Responsibilities

The Tasks Associated With These Responsibilities May Include

Working with the PI and collaborators to conceptualize, design, and implement studies of military brain health, occupational blast exposure, and injury prevention.
Identifying funding opportunities and leading or contributing to extramural proposals to Department of Defense and other federal and foundation sponsors (e.g., CDMRP, DARPA, ARPA-H, ONR, DHA, NIH).
Building and coordinating collaborations with academic, government, military, and industry partners, including multi-site and multi-institutional research teams.
Supporting the launch and execution of funded projects, including protocol development, regulatory submissions (IRB and DoD human research protections review), timelines, and sponsor reporting.
Establishing research procedures and data collection in military training and operational settings, in coordination with military leadership.
Applying epidemiologic and statistical methods to analyze data sets and interpret results.
Writing and submitting peer-reviewed manuscripts and managing the publication process.
Presenting results at scientific conferences and to military, government, and scientific stakeholders.
Representing the program in national and international scientific forums and working groups relevant to military health.
Mentoring and training junior research personnel.
Developing independent research projects and pursuing extramural funding to support them.

Qualifications

A doctoral degree, preferably a PhD or MD in epidemiology, public health, neuroscience, or a related health or biomedical science field is required by the start date. Preferred qualifications are: experience developing research proposals for extramural sponsors; experience managing research programs; experience with Department of Defense/Department of War (DoD/DoW) research.

Postdoctoral employment is normally limited to an individual who has been awarded a doctoral degree within the previous five years. added.description:
Position Information

Assistant/Associate/Full Professor

The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) Department of Statistics and Data Science in the College of AI, Cyber and Computing invites applications for two open-rank tenure-track/tenured positions (with a preference for Assistant Professor) of Statistics and Data Science beginning Fall 2027.

The University of Texas at San Antonio
(UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has also been recognized as a Top Employer in Texas by Forbes Magazine. Learn more online , on UT San Antonio Today or on X , Instagram , Facebook , YouTube or LinkedIn .

College of AI, Cyber and Computing (CAICC)

Established in September 2025, the College of AI, Cyber and Computing at The University of Texas at San Antonio brings together four departments: Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems and Cybersecurity, and Statistics and Data Science. Led by Founding Dean Jinjun Xiong, the college serves more than 5,400 students across a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs. Located at San Pedro I and II in downtown San Antonio, the college fosters interdisciplinary research and education in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, computing, statistics, and data science. As part of a Carnegie R1 research university, the college offers a collaborative environment for faculty to advance innovative research, engage with industry and academic partners, and prepare the next generation of technology leaders. For more information, visit https://caicc.utsa.edu .

Department of Statistics and Data Science

The Department of Statistics and Data Science in the College of AI, Cyber and Computing at The University of Texas at San Antonio comprises 15 full-time faculty members. The department offers two undergraduate degrees: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Statistics and a new BS in Data Science starting Fall 2027, as well as two master's degrees: the Master of Science (MS) in Statistics and Data Science and the MS in Data Analytics. The department also offers a doctoral degree in Applied Statistics. Our faculty and students have earned regional, national, and international recognition for excellence in research and teaching. For more about the department, please visit our department website: https://caicc.utsa.edu/statistics-data-science/

Salary Range:
Commensurate with education, experience, and qualifications.

Job Type:
Full Time

Position Summary

The Department of Statistics and Data Science at The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) invites applications for two open-rank faculty positions, with tenure-track or tenured appointments beginning in Fall 2027. One position focuses on Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Healthcare and Life Sciences; the other focuses on Statistical Data Science, Risk Modeling, and Decision Analytics. The positions offer opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration across UT San Antonio, including those arising from the recent integration of UT San Antonio and UT Health San Antonio. Appointments may be made at any academic rank, although preference will be given to candidates at the Assistant Professor rank.

Position 1: Data Science and AI for Healthcare and Life Sciences

The successful candidate will develop and apply innovative statistical and data science methods to advance biomedical discovery, clinical decision-making, healthcare delivery, and population health research. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to:

Statistical and machine learning methods for integrating and analyzing biomedical data, including medical imaging, electronic health records, and molecular and multi-omics data.
Causal inference, precision medicine, and personalized healthcare.
Longitudinal and survival analysis, and methods for generating real-world evidence from observational healthcare data.
Statistical genomics and computational approaches to biological discovery.
Privacy-preserving methods for biomedical and healthcare data.
Health equity and population health analytics.
Statistical methods for the development, validation, and evaluation of reliable and interpretable AI tools for healthcare and life sciences.

Position 2: Statistical Data Science, Risk Modeling, and Decision Analytics

The successful candidate will develop innovative statistical, machine learning, and data science methodologies for risk modeling, forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and decision analytics. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to:

Statistical and machine learning methods for risk assessment, forecasting, and predictive modeling.
Time series, spatiotemporal, and sequential data analysis, including anomaly detection.
Causal inference for decision-making and policy evaluation.
Reliability, resilience, and uncertainty quantification in complex systems.
Scalable statistical learning and data integration for decision support.
Robust, interpretable, and trustworthy statistical and AI methods for high-stakes decisions.
Optimization, stochastic modeling, and decision-making under uncertainty.

Successful candidates will establish and maintain an active research program, pursue external funding, teach undergraduate and graduate courses, mentor and advise students, and contribute to departmental, college, and university service. Expectations will be commensurate with the rank of appointment.

Qualifications

A Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a closely related field. Candidates nearing completion of their doctoral degree are eligible to apply, provided all degree requirements are expected to be completed before the appointment begins.
A strong record of, or demonstrated potential for, scholarly research in artificial intelligence, data science, statistics or closely related areas, with research interests aligned with one or both positions and consistent with the candidate's academic rank.
Evidence of effective teaching or the potential to teach undergraduate and graduate courses in statistics, biostatistics, data science, and related areas.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
The ability and willingness to work collegially and collaboratively with faculty, students, and research partners from broad disciplinary backgrounds.

This position may require the ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT San Antonio and its infrastructure per Texas EO-GA-48.

Application Process

To apply, applicants must upload the following:

A current curriculum vitae (CV) with complete contact information for at least three professional references.
A cover letter describing their interest in the position (Applicants may indicate interest in either or both faculty positions).
A research statement (3-page limit) describing research accomplishments, current interests, and future research plans.
A teaching statement (3-page limit) describing teaching philosophy, experience, and future teaching interests.

For candidates at the level of Associate or Full Professor, tenure is contingent upon Board of Regents approval.

Questions about the application can be addressed to Dr. Don Lien, Faculty Search Committee Chairperson, at don.lien@utsa.edu

For full consideration, applications should be submitted no later than 11:59 PM CST on 01/11/2027. Applications received after this date may be considered until the position is filled. At the discretion of the hiring department, this posting may close once a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received.

This position will work primarily on campus
. Travel and parking expenses are the employee’s responsibility.

This position is contingent upon a successful background check. Verification of a valid driver’s license and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) may be completed as applicable. Applicants selected must be able to show proof of eligibility to work in the United States by time of hire.

Equal Employment Opportunity

As an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, it is the policy of The University of Texas at San Antonio to promote and ensure equal employment opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or genetic information, and veteran status. The University is committed to the Affirmative Action Program in compliance with all government requirements to ensure nondiscrimination.

Work directly with researchers to implement research studies, simulate trading strategies, and develop algorithms to compete in financial markets.

added.description:
Join Our Team

As part of our Cinemark Universe, you'll discover fun opportunities with real growth potential and plenty of perks. With 500+ theatres and nearly 6,000 screens; we're truly a global presence of 20,000 movie lovers working together to make unforgettable experiences.

Role Summary

Job Title:
Senior Data Scientist - Strategic Pricing

Job Duties

Lead strategic pricing initiatives by partnering with business leadership to define pricing strategy, governance, and competitive positioning; drive cross-functional alignment across Marketing, Food and Beverages, Finance, Film and Operations teams. Develop and enhance pricing models including price elasticity, demand forecasting, promotions, and revenue optimization, to maximize revenue, margin, and total guest spend. Quantify and forecast pricing impact on key metrics including attendance, Average Ticket Price, Food & Beverages performance, and overall profitability to inform enterprise decision-making. Design and execute experiments including A/B tests and pilots, and apply causal inference methods to measure incremental impact and isolate true pricing effects on customer behavior and revenue. Leverage advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML), including Large Language Model (LLM) based workflows and Generative AI integration, to build scalable pricing frameworks, including scoring, prioritization, and decision-support tools that drive consistent, data-driven pricing actions. Translate analytics into actionable insights through dashboards, data storytelling, and executive communication to influence strategy and enable adoption across stakeholders. Some telecommuting is allowed, 1 day per week.

Minimum Requirements

Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field and five (5) years of experience in data analysis. Experience must include:

AI/ML modeling such as tree-based models, time-series, API integration and consumption and building end-to-end Machine Learning lifecycle;
Business and pricing strategy, revenue optimization, and pricing data science;
Pricing analytics including price elasticity modeling, promotion effectiveness measurement, revenue forecasting, and financial impact quantification;

As part of the Algorithms Research team, the Data Scientist will analyze data generated by our medical devices, develop advanced analytical methods, and generate insights that support product development, performance improvement, and clinical innovation. The ideal candidate combines strong data science expertise with a passion for solving complex healthcare and biomedical challenges.

Essential Functions

Analyze data collected by our medical devices and develop insights on system behavior, performance, and clinical utility.
Collaborate with algorithm engineers, clinical researchers, software developers, and product teams to define research objectives and translate findings into product improvements.
Design and execute data analysis studies to evaluate device performance and support research initiatives.
Process, clean, and validate large datasets from clinical studies, product testing, and real-world device usage.
Create visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for innovation through exploratory data analysis.
Contribute to technical documentation, research reports, publications, and regulatory submissions as needed.

Master's Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field required
PhD preferred
5+ years of relevant experience required, with an emphasis in information management required

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong programming experience in Python, SQL
Experience with data analysis and machine learning libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, and predictive modeling techniques.
Experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong data visualization and communication skills.
Ability to translate research questions into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Experience with biomedical signal analysis (e.g., ECG, EEG, physiological monitoring data) is preferred.
Knowledge of medical device development, clinical research, or healthcare data is a plus.

ZOLL is a fast-growing company that operates in more than 140 countries around the world. Job Summary

At American Electric Power, the AI Solutions & Enablement team develops the platforms, guardrails, and solutions that help teams across the company work more effectively through artificial intelligence and enterprise automation. We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to support solution architecture across that portfolio by contributing to reference architectures, evaluating the right capability for each business problem, and applying enterprise standards through practical engineering guardrails. This role will provide architecture support and technical guidance across internal teams and vendor partners, while remaining hands-on enough to validate patterns, help remove delivery blockers, and strengthen solutions in production when needed.

Job Description

What You'll Do

Cross-Capability Solution Architecture

Design solutions using the optimal mix of architectures across AI, automation, integration, and data.
Contribute to and maintain reference architectures, reusable components, and standard patterns spanning AI/ML and process automation solutions.
Work with business and technical teams to translate defined needs into scalable, secure designs that internal teams and vendor partners can implement consistently.

Technology Evaluation and Selection Support

Evaluate AI and automation platforms and services using established enterprise criteria, identify overlap and gaps, and provide recommendations on capabilities to standardize, retire, or pilot.
Apply and help refine criteria for when each tool is the appropriate choice, including tradeoffs, constraints, and fit-for-purpose considerations.
Translate those criteria into practical decision guidance, such as selection frameworks, comparison tools, and worked examples, that business partners and delivery teams can use when evaluating solution options.

Platforms, Tooling, and Enablement

Support the development and improvement of the internal AI and automation platforms and development environments teams use to build solutions, including cloud AI services and process automation platforms.
Create templates, starter kits, and reusable repositories that reduce friction from build to deploy for engineers, data scientists, and citizen builders.

Responsible AI, Automation Governance, and Risk Partnership

Apply responsible AI and automation standards through architecture reviews, established checklists, and controls.
Support solution designs that incorporate security, governance, reliability, and operability, including strong identity and access controls, auditability, observability, maintainability, and attention to the risks unattended automations can introduce.

Vendor Delivery Support

Review vendor architectures, code, and technical deliveries for fit, security, operability, and alignment to internal standards and patterns.
Provide technical guidance, help resolve delivery issues, and support alignment among stakeholders.

Preferred & Essential Skills

Experience contributing to the design of enterprise solutions across more than one capability, including AI/ML, process automation, integration, or data, with the ability to evaluate options deliberately.
Experience with enterprise AI, automation, integration, and cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS, Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, and related API and integration services, with the ability to evaluate when each technology is the appropriate fit.
Experience applying or contributing to tool selection criteria, reference patterns, and solution blueprints used by other teams.
Strong AI/ML workflow and practical MLOps knowledge, plus working experience with enterprise automation and integration patterns; hands-on when needed.
Security and governance fundamentals applied to AI and automated systems, with experience reviewing vendor technical deliverables and spotting risks early.
Effective communication and collaboration across business, technical, and vendor teams; balances standards with delivery realities and stays current with emerging practices.

What We're Looking For:

Education requirements are listed below:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related technical field is required.

Work Experience requirement listed below:

6 years of relevant work experience is required.An equivalent combination of education and related experience may be considered.

What You'll Get:

Base salary
Annual bonus
Long-term incentive
401(k) match
AEP Pension

Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

added.description:

Splunk, a Cisco company, is hiring an AI Solutions Architect to lead AI engagements with its largest customers. The role sits in pre-sales and owns the technical side of each deal: finding high-value use cases like threat detection, alert triage and root-cause analysis, designing architectures across Splunk’s security and observability products, and building proofs of concept with the AI Toolkit, AI Assistant, SPL, Python and MCP-based agent tooling. The architect also advises customers on data readiness and AI governance, supports account teams on proposals, and shares field insight with product teams and at events like .conf.

Candidates need 5+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, consulting or ML engineering, including 2+ years customer-facing. They also need hands-on generative AI experience (LLMs, RAG, evaluation), strong Python and cloud skills, familiarity with security or IT operations data, and the ability to explain technical ideas to executives. Splunk experience, agent-building, OpenTelemetry or SIEM/SOAR knowledge, AI governance frameworks, and regulated-industry background are pluses.

Description

Lead discovery with customer executives and practitioners to find AI use cases with clear business value, such as faster threat detection, anomaly detection, alert triage, and incident root-cause analysis.
Design end-to-end reference architectures that combine Splunk Cloud Platform, Enterprise Security, SOAR, ITSI, and Observability Cloud with ML models, LLMs, and agentic workflows.
Build and run proofs of concept and demos using the Splunk AI Toolkit, the Splunk AI Assistant, SPL, and Python, including integrations with external models and MCP-based agent tooling.
Advise customers on data readiness: which sources to onboard, how to normalize them, and how to govern AI use with privacy, security, and responsible-AI guardrails.
Partner with account teams to shape deal strategy, write technical sections of proposals, and size AI workloads.
Feed field insight back to product and engineering, and share reusable patterns through blogs, internal enablement, and talks at events such as .conf.

What You'll Bring

5+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, consulting, or data/ML engineering, with at least 3 years in customer-facing technical roles.
Hands-on experience building ML or generative AI solutions, including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, and model evaluation.
Strong Python skills and comfort with data pipelines, APIs, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Working knowledge of security operations, IT operations, or observability, and the machine data behind them: logs, metrics, traces, and events.
A record of explaining complex technical ideas clearly to both engineers and executives.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

Hands-on Splunk experience: SPL, the AI Toolkit (formerly MLTK), Enterprise Security, or Observability Cloud. Splunk certifications are a plus.
Experience building AI agents or tool-using LLM workflows, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and agent frameworks.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, SIEM and SOAR platforms, or AIOps tools.
Knowledge of AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or the EU AI Act.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Who We Are

We're a team driven by purpose, energized by possibility, and united by a

commitment to delivering an exceptional homeowner experience. Every day brings

opportunities to solve problems, make an impact, and help families create homes

they love. We move with urgency, hold ourselves to a high standard, and

excellence. We celebrate wins together, learn from challenges, and support one

another in reaching our full potential. The result is a culture built on trust,

accountability, and positive energy, where great people do great work because

exceptional service starts with exceptional people.

The Team You'll Join

Technology plays an increasingly important role in how we serve homeowners,

support our teams, and scale our business. The Information Technology team

connects people, processes, data, and systems to make work simpler, smarter, and

more effective. We partner across the organization to solve meaningful business

challenges, strengthen how information moves, and introduce technology in ways

that are practical, secure, and built for lasting adoption.

The Role You'll Play

The AI Architect owns the practical application of artificial intelligence and

automation across the organization. This role turns business challenges into

thoughtful, scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve access to

information, strengthen decision-making, and create better experiences for

employees and homeowners.

Working at the intersection of technology, operations, and change, the AI Architect

partners with teams across the business to identify high-value opportunities, design

and build AI-powered agents and workflows, connect systems and data, and support

successful adoption. This role helps shape an AI ecosystem that is useful,

responsible, secure, and aligned with how our business actually works.

What You'll Do

AI Solutions & Intelligent Automation

Research, evaluate, design, and implement AI-powered solutions that address

defined business needs and deliver measurable value.

Build and maintain intelligent agents, custom applications, and automated

workflows that retrieve information, complete tasks, and support day-to-day

operations.

Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions using AI

platforms, programming, APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

Test, troubleshoot, document, and continuously improve solutions to

strengthen accuracy, reliability, usability, and performance.

Business Process Improvement

Partner with leaders and subject matter experts to understand workflows,

pain points, decision points, and opportunities for simplification or

automation.

Redesign repetitive or manual processes to improve speed, consistency, data

quality, and employee experience.

Connect business applications and systems to improve information sharing,

reduce duplicate work, and create more seamless workflows.

Prioritize opportunities based on business impact, effort, risk, scalability, and

readiness for adoption rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.

Data, Reporting & Business Intelligence

Develop automated reporting and information solutions that help leaders

access timely, relevant, and actionable insights.

Create AI-enabled tools that organize and summarize information, identify

patterns, and support informed business decisions.

Partner with data owners to improve the accuracy, accessibility, governance,

and usefulness of information used by AI solutions.

Support dashboards, performance tracking, and recurring reporting through

Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft 365, and other business intelligence tools.

AI Adoption, Enablement & Responsible Use

Help employees and leaders understand how to use AI tools effectively,

responsibly, and with appropriate human judgment.

Create practical guidance, documentation, training, and support that build

confidence and encourage consistent adoption of new solutions.

Establish and reinforce standards for data security, privacy, accuracy, access,

testing, and responsible AI use in partnership with IT and business leaders.

Monitor solution performance and user feedback, measure impact, and

identify opportunities for continued improvement or broader application.

Stay current on emerging AI, automation, and business technology

capabilities and recommend new approaches when they can meaningfully

improve the business or homeowner experience.

Five or more years of experience in AI implementation, workflow automation,

software development, business process improvement, data analytics, or a

related technical field.

Hands-on experience building practical business solutions with AI platforms

and automation tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, ChatGPT,

Claude, Microsoft Power Automate, Make, Zapier, or comparable

technologies.

Working knowledge of programming and data tools such as Python,

JavaScript, SQL, APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

Strong business analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to

understand how work gets done and translate operational needs into scalable

technical solutions.

Experience balancing innovation with responsible governance, including data

privacy, security, accuracy, permissions, and appropriate human oversight.

Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to

prioritize multiple initiatives, manage dependencies, and move work from

concept through adoption.

Clear and approachable communication skills, with the ability to explain

technical concepts to nontechnical audiences and build trusted cross-

functional partnerships.

Curiosity, resourcefulness, and a continuous improvement mindset, with

comfort testing, learning, challenging assumptions, and adapting as

technology evolves.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business

Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred; an equivalent

considered.

What you’ll be doing…

As the Principal Architect for Verizon’s Enterprise AI Platform, you will provide technical leadership for a comprehensive 5-layer architecture serving all global business units. Your primary mandate is to ensure architectural coherence across the ecosystem, aligning Gateway routing with the Registry’s RBAC models, integrating the ADLC pipeline with established guardrail frameworks, and providing end-to-end token visibility for FinOps. In this capacity, you will author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), spearhead Architecture Review Board (ARB) submissions, and conduct rigorous build-vs-buy analyses supported by multi-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models. This principal-level individual contributor role requires the ability to exert technical influence and drive consensus across the organization through design excellence and strategic vision.

Direct the 5-layer architecture stack — Encompassing Model Foundation, Agent Factory, Agent Runtime, Experience, and Control Plane layers. Responsibilities include defining formal layer boundaries, interface contracts, and interaction patterns to ensure platform scalability.
Establish and govern architectural standards — Defining API conventions, enterprise security patterns, and observability requirements. Lead component reviews and provide consultative oversight for Business Unit agent architectures to ensure platform alignment.
Lead technical strategy and procurement evaluations — Executing complex build-vs-buy analyses for platform components and develop comprehensive 3-year TCO models. Formulate multi-cloud strategies balancing central platform services with decentralized requirements.
Architect enterprise security and governance frameworks — Designing multi-stage security flows encompassing identity, authentication, execution safety, and audit. Engineer Responsible AI (RAI) guardrail architectures and ensure compliance with emerging international regulations.
Stakeholder engagement and pattern evangelization — Collaborating with executive leadership and external cloud partners on capacity planning and integration. Contribute high-impact reference architectures to the enterprise library to drive architectural maturity.

What we’re looking for…

What You'll Be Doing…

Principal-level architect with a demonstrated focus on technical interface contracts and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling. Candidates must possess a proven history of designing scalable distributed platforms and establishing architectural credibility with both executive leadership and engineering teams through rigorous Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Deep technical proficiency in Large Language Model (LLM) architecture—including attention mechanisms, KV-cache, context windows, and token economics—is required, alongside the ability to substantiate build-vs-buy recommendations with robust, 3-year financial models. Experience in software or platform architecture, with designing AI/ML systems.

Experience with agentic development and design patterns. (LangGraph and Google ADK)
Experience with distributed systems: service mesh, API gateways, event-driven patterns, multi-tenancy, and data isolation.
Experience with Kubernetes at enterprise scale.
Experience with LLM architecture — transformers, attention, KV-cache, context windows, token economics, and routing patterns.
Experience in multi-cloud environments (GCP and AWS).
Experience with API platform design: OpenAI-compatible interfaces, SDK design, developer experience.
Experience presenting architecture recommendations to VP/SVP-level leadership.

A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an MBA.
Experience architecting agentic AI systems — agent runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, memory systems.
Experience with security architecture: zero-trust (SPIFFE/SPIRE), mTLS, OPA, Vault, and regulated environments (CPNI, PCI-DSS).
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol design.
Experience designing RAG architectures (vector databases, hybrid search, re-ranking).
Experience with MLOps/LLMOps at scale (model registry, RLHF/RLAIF).

added.description:
Description

JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior AI Automation & Integration Engineer leads the technical execution of the AI Center of Excellence's automation, integration, and enablement capability. Working within the direction established through BS&A's AI engineering standards and governance model, this role defines the implementation patterns, reference components, and reliability standards that other teams build on, and is accountable for those decisions holding up as the AI program scales.

This is an integration, automation, and enablement role, not a model-research, model-training, or GPU-infrastructure role. The focus is internal. AI in our products is owned elsewhere. The work is deciding how approved models connect to BS&A's systems and data, defining the reusable patterns other teams build on, and owning the reliability and cost of those decisions in production.

Where the AI Automation & Integration Engineer configures and integrates within established patterns, this role defines them: how standards become working capabilities, which reference architectures are practical, what belongs in the shared foundation, how evaluation and observability are implemented, and whether a proposed solution conforms to standard. This is a hands-on technical role rather than a people-management role, though it mentors and sets the technical bar for the rest of the capability.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Leadership For Shared AI Capabilities

Lead the implementation architecture for BS&A's shared AI capabilities, including model APIs and gateways, MCP-based and comparable tool integrations, orchestration workflows, shared frameworks, runtime services, evaluation, monitoring, and cost controls.
Translate BS&A's AI engineering standards into practical engineering patterns, working capabilities, reference implementations, and technical guardrails that teams can consistently apply.
Decide, in partnership with the VP of AI Transformation and CTO, what the CoE builds centrally, what departmental engineering builds on shared capabilities, and what is purchased, configured, or intentionally not pursued.
Establish and maintain reliability, cost, maintainability, and scalability standards as adoption grows across departments.

Solution Engineering & Delivery

Default to configuring what BS&A already owns or can buy, and build custom only when nothing available does the job.
Lead the build of enterprise AI solutions where centralized ownership is appropriate, and design the shared components departmental engineering teams build on top of.
Own technical decisions on build, buy, and configure, including proof-of-concept work and analysis of cost, quality, latency, security, scalability, and maintainability for the highest-stakes solutions.
Apply and refine the least-expensive-model-capable-of-the-job principle across the portfolio, balancing quality, cost, latency, security, and maintainability rather than optimizing a single solution.

Production Readiness, Reliability & Cost Ownership

Own the technical readiness assessment for production reviews, complementing the business evidence compiled by the AI Portfolio Analyst and the data, infrastructure, and security assessments owned by IT & Security.
Own monitoring, evaluation, and cost-tracking instrumentation standards across all production AI solutions, not only those built centrally.
Lead incident response for CoE-managed components with IT & Security, and drive root-cause fixes that prevent recurrence.

Standards Execution & Governance Partnership

Enablement, Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

updated.title: AI Engineer
updated.description:
GameStop is looking for an Applied AI Engineer
who combines hands-on AI capability with strong business judgment.

We want a highly motivated individual with tremendous work ethic who can identify a major business problem, understand its economics, build a solution using AI, and demonstrate measurable results.

We're interested in what you've actually built, who's using it, and the impact it's delivered.

You'll work directly with Ryan Cohen and the GameStop team
to improve how the business operates.

What You'll Do

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, reduce costs, improve inventory decisions, save time, and better serve customers.
Prioritize problems based on business impact and the effort required to solve them.
Build and deploy AI agents, applications, and automated workflows.
Connect AI to business systems, databases, documents, and operational processes.
Work directly with the people using your solutions and continuously improve them based on real-world results.
Measure accuracy, reliability, operating costs, adoption, and financial impact.

What We're Looking For

Strong Business Judgment

Understand how companies make money, where resources are wasted, and which problems deserve attention.
Focus on measurable business outcomes rather than technology for its own sake.

Hands-On Technical Ability

Build solutions personally, from initial concept through production deployment.
Combine AI models, code, APIs, data, and automation tools to solve real business problems.

Demonstrated Results

Have a track record of applying AI to meaningful business challenges.
Can show working systems, real-world adoption, and measurable outcomes.

Ownership and Urgency

Operate independently with a strong bias for action.
Move quickly, overcome obstacles, and take responsibility for results.
Remain accountable for your solutions after deployment.

Clear Communication

Explain complex technical solutions in straightforward business terms.
Demonstrate what you built, why it matters, and how you know it works.

How To Apply

Applications must include proof of work.

Submit your resume or professional profile along with one or two examples of significant problems you've solved using AI.

For Each Example, Include

The Problem: What was happening, who was affected, and why it mattered.
Your Solution: What you built and how AI contributed.
Your Contribution: What you personally designed, implemented, integrated, and operated.
The Results: Before-and-after measurements, timeframe, scale, and costs. Clearly distinguish measured results from estimates.
The Evidence: A working product, recorded demo, code sample, architecture walkthrough, or documented case study.

At least one example must demonstrate a solution deployed and used in an actual business environment.

Redacted examples and confidential interview walkthroughs are welcome. Please do not share proprietary information without permission.

What To Expect

Be prepared to demonstrate your work and explain the technical decisions, tradeoffs, failures, and improvements behind it.

We're looking for builders who deliver measurable business results
, not people who simply understand AI concepts.

Location

Remote candidates will be considered, with some time required in Dallas, Texas.
